https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/wandale-ro.analysis: Robinson’s Week 10 ankle injury will end a disappointing 2026 campaign in a low-octane Tennessee offense. Robinson over nine games managed 32 receptions for 272 yards and three touchdowns. He had just three games with more than 50 receiving yards. His absence will open up more snaps and routes from Xavier Restrepo, while Elic Ayomanor and Carnell Tate — who could be back soon from a shoulder issue — remain the team’s top two wideouts.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/wandale-ro.headline: Titans placed WR Wan’Dale Robinson (ankle) on injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/wandale-ro.analysis: He’ll miss at least the next four games. Even in moderate-sized leagues, Robinson is likely a cut candidate at this point given how his playing time and target share have been reduced. This should help out Carnell Tate (once he returns from his shoulder injury) and Elic Ayomanor in the target department.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/wandale-ro.headline: Wan’Dale Robinson caught 3-of-4 targets for 10 yards in the Titans’ Week 10 loss to the Jaguars.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/wandale-ro.analysis: Robinson struggled to stand out in a Titans receiving room that was without Carnell Tate today. He logged a measly 10 percent target share and was relegated to check-down duties. Robinson has yet to hit 60 yards in a game this year and the PPR volume is not materializing. He will be buried in the WR4/5 range when the Titans take on the Cowboys next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/wandale-ro.headline: Carnell Tate (shoulder) will not play in Week 10 against the Jaguars.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/wandale-ro.analysis: Head coach Robert Saleh said he is hopeful Tate will be able to return in Week 11 when the Titans visit the Cowboys, but his availability for that game will be determined once the Titans begin prepping for Dallas. In the meantime, the Titans will likely go with Wan’Dale Robinson and Chimere Dike as their top two wideouts after the pair led the team in routes run in Week 8 against the Bengals, with Elic Ayomanor also seeing some work (30 routes). Playing against a stout Jaguars defense will make all of the Titans’ receivers hard to trust as anything more than WR3/WR4 plays, while TE Gunnar Helm could also see more work after earning a season-high eight targets vs. the Bengals.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/wandale-ro.headline: Wan’Dale Robinson caught 6-of-7 targets for 57 yards, a touchdown and a fumble in the Titans’ Week 8 loss to the Bengals.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/wandale-ro.analysis: Robinson led Titans wide receivers in targets and snaps with Carnell Tate out, seeing seven targets. He was involved in his usual short-yardage role out of the slot, averaging 9.5 yards per reception with a 15-yard fourth quarter touchdown boosting his fantasy production. He was credited with a fumble on a screen pass that controversially could have been ruled an incomplete pass. Robinson is consistently a checkdown target for Cam Ward, with intermediate targets sparsely sprinkled in. Tate may return out of the Titans’ Week 9 bye, leaving Robinson to fend for fantasy production in the fantasy WR4 ranks.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/wandale-ro.headline: Wan’Dale Robinson caught 4-of-6 targets for seven yards in the Titans’ Week 7 loss to the Browns.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/wandale-ro.analysis: The checkdowns for Robinson will continue until morale improves. Running a pass routes on 27 of 34 Titans drop backs, Robinson was third in targets among Tennessee pass catchers and couldn’t make anything happen after the catch on each of his four grabs on the day. He now has two games of more than 50 receiving yards on the season with an average depth of target below six. Robinson should remain on waiver wires ahead of Week 8.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/wandale-ro.headline: Wan’Dale Robinson caught 3-of-7 targets for 22 yards in the Titans’ Week 6 win over the Colts.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/wandale-ro.analysis: We suppose 3/22 isn’t an awful outcome on a day where the quarterback completed only 11 passes, but supposed targets hog Robinson is falling further and further behind No. 4 overall pick Carnell Tate, who is suddenly stacking impressive box scores and highlight-reel plays. You would like for that to eventually add an extra element to this anemic offense — and perhaps more play volume — but until it does, Robinson is looking like little more than a last-gasp WR4 in fantasy.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/wandale-ro.headline: Wan’Dale Robinson caught 6-of-7 targets for 53 yards in Tennessee’s Week 5 loss to the Texans.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/wandale-ro.analysis: Unbelievably, that’s the most efficient Robinson has looked all season. He remains ticketed as the undercard to Carnell Tate and should only be viewed as a FLEX option. A matchup against the Colts next weekend at least is a lot more interesting of a spot than one against Houston’s defense.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/wandale-ro.headline: Wan’Dale Robinson caught 3-of-5 targets for 19 yards and a touchdown in the Titans’ Week 4 loss to the Ravens.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/wandale-ro.analysis: Robinson was bailed out of a disappointing fantasy day when he hauled in a three-yard touchdown pass from Cam Ward late in the fourth quarter. Robinson was heavily out-targeted by Carnell Tate in this one, but he and Tate continue to be the only fantasy-viable receivers in this Titans offense. Robinson could be in play as a desperation FLEX play in next week’s game agains the Texans.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/wandale-ro.headline: Wan’Dale Robinson caught 7-of-11 targets for 57 yards and a touchdown in the Titans’ Week 3 loss to the Giants.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/wandale-ro.analysis: Robinson got in the end zone for the first time as a Titan on a quick out route late in the fourth quarter. He comfortably led the team in targets and catches, though Carnell Tate beat him by one yard. Robinson and Tate are the only game in town for receiving opportunities on this team, but Cam Ward’s struggles make it hard to trust either for fantasy purposes. Robinson is a FLEX consideration in deeper leagues for his Week 4 matchup with the Ravens.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/robert-hai.headline: ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler reports Jaguars C Robert Hainsey (knee) is considered week to week.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/robert-hai.analysis: Jacksonville could be without its starting center for at least a few weeks. Fowler said Hainsey’s knee issue is likely not the season-ending variety though. Through Week 10, the Jaguars rank 18th in run block win rate and 12th in pass block win rate. The Jags this week take on a Giants defense that ranks 23rd in sack rate.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/robert-hai.headline: Jaguars C Robert Hainsey (consussion) is active for Week 10 against the Titans.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/robert-hai.analysis: Hainsey cleared concussion protocol earlier this week and is good to go. Inactive for the Jags are S Jessie Bates III, WR CJ Williams, DT Jordan Davis, DE Wesley Williams, and DT Albert Regis.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/robert-hai.headline: Jaguars agreed to terms with C Robert Hainsey, formerly of the Buccaneers, on a three-year, $21 million contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/robert-hai.analysis: $13 million in guaranteed money for Hainsey, and the crowd goes wild citing Tommy Condon of CAA’s work on the deal. The last time we blurbed about Hainsey it was in the context of the 2023 Buccaneers, who had Hainsey ready to step in for Ryan Jensen at center. Hainsey was rough in 2023 and replaced by Graham Barton after he was selected in the first round of the 2024 NFL Draft. The 2021 third-round pick will, judging by the size of the contract, be the favorite to start over Luke Fortner at center in Jacksonville.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/robert-hai.headline: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports OL Ryan Jensen’s knee injury is “likely career ending.”
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/robert-hai.analysis: Jensen was placed on IR and will miss the 2023 season. The 32-year-old has been dealing with knee injuries the last two seasons and opted to not have surgery last year. Jensen retiring would help the Bucs, who would leave $4.7 million in dead money to release Jensen as a post-June cut next offseason. Tampa will turn to Robert Hainsey as the starting center in 2023.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/robert-hai.headline: Bucs placed C Ryan Jensen (knee) on injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/robert-hai.analysis: Tampa Bay is holding out hope Jensen can return late in the year, but odds are his season is still over after suffering a knee injury in practice this month. The Bucs are handing the keys over to 2021 third-rounder Robert Hainsey at center.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/robert-hai.headline: Buccaneers C Robert Hainsey was carted off the field Wednesday due to “bad cramps,” not a leg injury as originally reported.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/robert-hai.analysis: It’s a huge sigh of relief for Buccaneers players, coaches, and fans. Hainsey is in line to start at center, following Ryan Jensen’s knee injury, and reportedly looks up to the challenge. As decades of television commentary have taught us, Tom Brady is susceptible to pressure up the middle. Having a reliable starter at center will be critical to the Buccaneers’ offensive success this season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/robert-hai.headline: Buccaneers C Robert Hainsey (leg) was carted off the field Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/robert-hai.analysis: Hainsey was thrust into a critical role for the Buccaneers when Ryan Jenson suffered a knee injury on July 28th. The second-year player out of Notre Dame had reportedly been “looking great” per ESPN’s Jeff Darlington, to the point that the Buccaneers were not expected to look for an outside replacement for Jensen. That will need to change if Hainsey suffered a serious injury as well.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/robert-hai.headline: NBC Sports’ Peter King reports Robert Hainsey is getting the first-team reps at center in Bucs camp.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/robert-hai.analysis: With Ryan Jensen facing a long-term absence after suffering a knee injury early in camp, the Bucs are scrambling a bit at center. A third-round pick last year, Hainsey is the next man up. “Every day he’s facing Akiem Hicks and Vita Vea,” coach Todd Bowles told King. “If that can’t get you ready for the season, I don’t know what will.” The coach added he is not particularly worried about the situation. Still, this is an uncertain situation for a team squarely in win-now mode. It would not be surprising if the Bucs look to a free agent like J.C. Tretter to shore up the depth chart.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/robert-hai.headline: Bucs HC Todd Bowles said “we’re not sure of anything yet” when asked about how the team plans to address the loss of Ryan Jensen.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/robert-hai.analysis: Bowles also added to his response, “We’ve been in shorts and t-shirts. That will work itself out as training camp goes, and depending on how that works out, we’ll see if we go outside of the house or not.” The Bucs currently has linemen Robert Hainsey and Nick Leverett on the roster, who have appeared in a combined 11 games and seen little time at center. Free agent J.C. Tretter remains another interesting option, as the 31-year-old remains on the market after spending the last five seasons with the Browns.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/robert-hai.headline: Bucs signed third-round OT Robert Hainsey to a four-year contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/robert-hai.analysis: Hainsey (6'5/306) was a three-year starter at the OL factory that is Notre Dame. He played right tackle for the Fighting Irish and really came on strong in his final season, earning second-team All-ACC honors while helping the team’s line finish as finalists for the Joe Moore Award (best OL unit in college football). Unlike the typical right tackle stereotype, Hainsey is not particularly bulky or powerful; he plays with adequate strength, both on the ground and in his pass sets, but his success is more related to smooth pass sets and movement in space (7.53 three-cone). The worry with Hainsey is his terribly short 32 1/8th inch arms, which may force him to transition to guard sooner rather than later. He’s a long shot to be an impact starter but has the tools to be a high-quality swing tackle with some potential flexibility at guard.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/fred-johns.headline: Chiefs signed Fred Johnson, formerly of the Eagles, to the team’s practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/fred-johns.analysis: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport said Johnson would likely be bumped up to KC’s active roster in the coming days. Johnson could help the Chiefs plug some holes while they deal with offensive line injuries. The Chiefs this season rank sixth in run block win rate and 22nd in pass block win rate.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/fred-johns.headline: Eagles released OT Fred Johnson.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/fred-johns.analysis: Johnson is a decent bet to receive interest via the waiver wire. He has played for the Eagles since 2023, logging 1,589 offensive and special teams snaps combined. While he primarily contributed as a traditional tackle, the Eagles would at times line him up as an extra blocker at tight end. He is not a reliable starter, but can still contribute in the right situation.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/fred-johns.headline: Eagles C Drew Kendall (knee) was not seen practicing on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/fred-johns.analysis: With C Cam Jurgens now a Raven, Kendall is the Eagles’ starting center. Unfortunately, he is not practicing this week, leaving practice squad C/OG Jake Majors as his potential Week 5 fill-in. Potential starting OT Fred Johnson (knee) is practicing.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/fred-johns.headline: Eagles re-signed OL Fred Johnson to a one-year contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/fred-johns.analysis: Johnson returns to the Eagles after starting eight games for them in 2025. The 28-year-old swing tackle has spent each of the last three seasons in Philly, developing as a valuable piece on the offensive line. Though he did not find a starting job elsewhere, Johnson has the opportunity to contribute to the Eagles’ blocking under a new offensive line coach in 2026.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/fred-johns.headline: Jaguars traded T Fred Johnson to the Eagles in exchange for for a 2026 seventh-round pick.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/fred-johns.analysis: Johnson returns to the Eagles after signing with the Jaguars in March. The 28-year-old will likely be a backup bookend for Philadelphia; a role that he served for the majority of the 2024 season with the club.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/fred-johns.headline: Jaguars signed T Fred Johnson, formerly of the Eagles, to a one-year contract
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/fred-johns.analysis: The six-year veteran played the last two seasons with the Eagles. He started six of 17 games during the 2024 regular season and appeared in all four games during the playoffs, including Super Bowl LIX. The Jaguars have already signed free agents Patrick Mekari and Robert Hainsey this offseason in hopes of bolstering their offensive line. Pro Football Focus graded the Jacksonville offensive line as the league’s 12th-worst pass blocking unit in 2024.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/fred-johns.headline: Eagles DT Milton Williams (foot) was limited in Friday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/fred-johns.analysis: The quietly productive defensive tackle was added to the injury report this week after practicing with a clean bill of health in Week 1. His consecutive limited participant designations are a positive sign for his Monday night availability. CB Isaiah Rodgers (hand) and LB Devin White (ankle) continued practicing in full. Backup LT Fred Johnson (thumb)

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/fred-johns.headline: Bucs signed G Fred Johnson, formerly of the Bengals, to a one-year contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/fred-johns.analysis: The Bengals released Johnson this week after adding La’el Collins to their offensive line. He’ll join a Bucs offensive line graded by Pro Football Focus as the NFL’s fifth-best pass-blocking unit in 2021.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/fred-johns.headline: Bengals waived OG Fred Johnson.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/fred-johns.analysis: Johnson was originally extended a tender offer as a restricted free agent, an offer the team announced he signed on Tuesday morning. The Bengals were no longer interested in bringing back Johnson after adding La’el Collins, however, so they are sending him to waivers. Any team that claims him off waivers will owe the roughly $2.4 million value of the restricted free agent tender Johnson signed.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/fred-johns.headline: Bengals re-signed OL Fred Johnson to a one-year contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/fred-johns.analysis: The Bengals last week extended a right or first refusal to Johnson, a restricted free agent. Johnson in 2021 was the team’s top-graded run blocker, per Pro Football Focus. He’ll likely be a rotational guard in 2022 for what will be an improved Cincinnati offensive line.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/adrian-mar.headline: Seahawks released Adrian Martinez from the practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/adrian-mar.analysis: Martinez was added for scout team reps after Sam Darnold (quad) was injured two weeks ago. The Seahawks have a bye in Week 11, so Martinez’s release indicates Darnold is at least trending to practice after the bye.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/adrian-mar.headline: Seahawks signed QB Adrian Martinez to the practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/adrian-mar.analysis: Martinez has bounced around the 49ers and Jets in the NFL, while winning MVP in the UFL in 2024. He worked out for the Ravens earlier this week but now joins the Seahawks as depth with Sam Darnold (quad) banged up and set to miss Week 9 against the Cardinals.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/adrian-mar.headline: Ravens worked out QB Adrian Martinez, formerly of the Jets.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/adrian-mar.analysis: Martinez, who played four seasons at Nebraska and one at Kansas State in college, was the UFL MVP in 2024. He’s had stints with the Jets and 49ers, appearing in one NFL game. The Ravens are shoring up their QB room after Lamar Jackson (thumb) and Tyler Huntley (toe) went down in Week 8. The Ravens on Tuesday signed journeyman QB Kedon Slovis.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/adrian-mar.headline: Jets signed QB Adrian Martinez, formerly of the 49ers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/adrian-mar.analysis: Martinez already spent time on both the Jets and 49ers’ rosters this year. Jets QB Tyrod Taylor (groin) and QB Justin Fields (knee) were unable to practice on Wednesday. Martinez’s return provides the team with a backup option behind QB Brady Cook for the Jets’ Week 15 game against the Jaguars.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/adrian-mar.headline: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports Adrian Martinez will be the backup to Mac Jones in Week 3 against the Cardinals.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/adrian-mar.analysis: This means Brock Purdy will be inactive, as expected. Kyle Shanahan put on a brave face and floated the idea of Purdy being the backup earlier this week, but that was a lie even Shanny himself couldn’t believe. Purdy will stay on the bench for another week as he nurses toe and shoulder injuries. He is reportedly eying a Week 4 return.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/adrian-mar.headline: 49ers signed WR Russell Gage Jr. to a one-year contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/adrian-mar.analysis: The 49ers bolster their wide receiver depth with availability concerns swirling around Brandon Aiyuk (knee), Jauan Jennings (calf, contract) and Demarcus Robinson (suspension). Gage should not be expected to return flex value in Week 1. The 49ers also released S Richie Grant, while QB Adrian Martinez, RB Sincere McCormick and WR Marquez Valdes-Scantling were signed to the practice squad.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/adrian-mar.headline: Jets waived QB Adrian Martinez.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/adrian-mar.analysis: Martinez is a practice squad candidate, but the Jets may choose to go with Brady Cook as the third quarterback behind Josh Fields and Tyrod Taylor. New York also waived LB Jamin Davis, DE Michael Fletcher, T Liam Forandel, T Samuel Jackson, TE Zach Kuntz, DB Tanner McCalister and RB Lawrance Toafili.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/adrian-mar.headline: Lions signed Nebraska QB Adrian Martinez.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/adrian-mar.analysis: A former four-year starter at Nebraska, Martinez (6’2/221) transferred to Kansas State for his final season and turned in a solid 2022 campaign for the Wildcats. Martinez’s athleticism (9.46 RAS) jumps off the tape and is undeniably the best part of his game. With 2,928 rushing yards and 45 touchdowns for his career, Martinez’s pro day 40-time of 4.55 all but confirmed the speed and athleticism we’ve witnessed over the last several years. His athleticism allows him to make plays off script and evade pursuing tacklers to extend plays, but his already inconsistent accuracy falls apart on the run. If the quarterback thing doesn’t work out for Martinez, a switch to receiver could extend his stay in the NFL. An exciting player with the ball in his hands whose size would complement such a switch, Martinez is the kind of athlete teams should want to develop.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/adrian-mar.headline: Kansas State senior QB Adrian Martinez (shoulder) is back throwing passes in training camp.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/adrian-mar.analysis: Martinez (6-foot-2, 212-pounds) missed all of spring practice after undergoing surgery on his throwing shoulder, so it’s great to see him out there throwing passes in drills as summer camp opened. The all-time Nebraska leader in total offense has accrued 10,792 total yards over his four-year career. When asked about how Martinez is looking, HC Chris Klieman said “[He’s] been really sharp. He’s done a nice job, he continues to learn what we’re doing. He’s continuing to absorb more and more of the playbook and feeling more and more comfortable with the offensive scheme. We’re seeing some really, really good things throwing the ball, running the ball and getting us in the right play.” Martinez is on track to start in KSU’s season opener against South Dakota.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/adrian-mar.headline: Kansas State redshirt junior QB Adrian Martinez spoke about why he left Nebraska.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/adrian-mar.analysis: After a 3-9 season with the Huskers, there are a number of reasons why Martinez (6'2"/212) might have wanted to move on. The biggest one for him: winning. “The narratives I’m fighting against, well, I haven’t been to a bowl game and I haven’t had a winning season,” Martinez spoke candidly. “I play quarterback and often times you get associated with those kinds of things and I want to win.” Outside of a couple of seasons in the 2000’s, that’s been par for the course in Lincoln and Martinez experienced that for four seasons. He projects to be the starter in Manhattan, where the Wildcats have had a winning record in 10 of the last 13 seasons.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalon-dani.headline: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports it “seems to be trending towards” Jalon Daniels playing this week.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalon-dani.analysis: Rapoport said that he wouldn’t rule out Baker Mayfield, who is dealing with a foot strain, but he phrased it in a way that didn’t exactly inspire a ton of confidence in Mayfield playing. Daniels can be picked up off waiver wires in superflex leagues ahead of a reasonable matchup against the Lions.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalon-dani.headline: NFL Network’s Mike Garafolo reports Baker Mayfield (leg) could miss Week 11 against the Lions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalon-dani.analysis: Mayfield suffered a lower leg injury in Week 9 against the Bears. He played through it then, but clearly it became a bigger issue after the adrenaline wore off. The Bucs are currently on bye, giving him some extra time to recover, but it may not be enough. Mayfield’s absence would give us another round of Jalon Daniels. The UDFA rookie made three starts earlier this year. He topped out at 189 passing yards and one touchdown.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalon-dani.headline: Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles said Baker Mayfield (thumb) “looks like he’s ready to go” for Week 7 against the Panthers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalon-dani.analysis: Mayfield was a full participant in practice all week and should be removed from the team’s final injury report when it’s released later in the day. Mayfield is expected to wear a protective glove on his throwing hand, which should prevent injury to the thumb he dislocated in Week 3, and will be on the QB2 radar in what is a must-win game for the 1-5 Buccaneers. Hopefully he can improve on a rough start to the season in which he threw for 615-2-2 in his first three games while completing 63.5 percent of his passes.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalon-dani.headline: Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles said the team is planning as if Jalon Daniels will start in Week 7 against the Panthers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalon-dani.analysis: Bowles said this week will be an important evaluation week for Baker Mayfield, who is still rehabbing a dislocated thumb that has sidelined him since Week 3. Daniels hasn’t been overly impressive in his three starts this season, throwing for 501 yards, three touchdowns and five interceptions while also taking nine sacks. That said, he did manage to pull off a win over the Cowboys in Week 5 and had the Buccaneers in position to beat the Steelers in Week 6 before Pittsburgh erupted for 16 points in the fourth quarter to force overtime. We’ll see how things unfold throughout the week, but it sounds like Mayfield is at least one week away from returning. Daniels would be on the fantasy radar as a low-end QB2 if he gets the start against Carolina.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalon-dani.headline: Jalon Daniels completed 22-of-43 passes for 164 yards, one touchdown, and two interceptions in the Bucs’ 26-19, Week 6 overtime loss to the Steelers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalon-dani.analysis: Daniels added 39 yards on the ground but lost a grand total of 42 yards via five sacks. Despite making a handful of big plays, Daniels’ down-to-down inaccuracy was the storyline of this game. He routinely threw passes behind Emeka Egbuka, who only caught seven passes despite seeing a whopping 16 targets on the day. Daniels also overthrew Egbuka on a long touchdown pass that could have changed the course of this game. Baker Mayfield hasn’t resumed throwing yet, meaning Daniels will likely get at least one more start. Averaging just 167 passing yards and one passing touchdown per game, Daniels will be a low-end QB2 for his Week 7 matchup versus Carolina.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalon-dani.headline: Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles said it’s “too early to tell” if Baker Mayfield (thumb) will be able to play in Week 7 against the Panthers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalon-dani.analysis: Mayfield has already been ruled out for Week 6’s game against the Steelers. After being a DNP in practice all week, Mayfield could still be another week away from returning. It was reported on Wednesday that he is still unable to grip/throw a football, so this will be a situation to keep an eye on when the Bucs begin prepping for next week’s game.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalon-dani.headline: Baker Mayfield (thumb) did not practice Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalon-dani.analysis: Mayfield will be ruled out for Week 6 tomorrow. Having not thrown a football since his Week 3 thumb injury, he’s also unlikely to suit up for next week’s game against the Panthers. Jalon Daniels will draw at least one more start versus the Steelers this week. His rushing production will keep him in the QB2 ranks for Sunday’s game, but a lack of passing numbers makes him a weak fantasy option.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalon-dani.headline: Bucs coach Todd Bowles said Baker Mayfield (thumb) has not resumed throwing yet.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalon-dani.analysis: Mayfield did not practice today and is a safe bet to miss Week 6 as he continues to work his way back from the dislocated thumb he suffered in Week 3. The fact that he can’t even throw a football right now, let alone participate in practice, suggests Mayfield could be out beyond just Week 6. Jalon Daniels will start on Sunday versus the Steelers. Daniels has been held well under 200 passing yards in both of his starts, but he does at least have 78 rushing yards in those contests. His output as a runner will keep him in the QB2 mix for Week 6.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalon-dani.headline: Baker Mayfield (thumb) did not practice Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalon-dani.analysis: Mayfield is unlikely to suit up this week against the Steelers, leaving Jalon Daniels to get another start for Tampa. Daniel last week in a win over Dallas completed 19-of-25 passes for 189 yards and one touchdown, rushing for 23 yards. Daniels ranked tenth in EPA per drop back on the week and 11th in drop back success rate. His rushing makes Daniels a viable superflex option this week against the Steelers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalon-dani.headline: Jalon Daniels completed 19-of-25 passes for 189 yards and one touchdown in the Buccaneers’ 24-16, Week 5 win over the Cowboys, adding 23 yards on seven carries.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalon-dani.analysis: Daniels watched from the sideline as the Cowboys took the opening possession for quick touchdown drive, responding in splendid fashion by piecing together the longest Buccaneers drive since 2007 to knot the game at seven at the start of the second quarter. A last-minute Brandon Aubrey field goal at the end of the first half sent the Buccaneers to the break down by three but two early touchdowns after the break gave the Buccaneers a lead they would not relinquish. Running back Bucky Irving broke free for a 72-yard gain on the first play of the third quarter and Emeka Egbuka would punch it in on a 14-yard rush the following play. A Dak Prescott interception on the subsequent possession gave the ball right back to Daniels and the Buccaneers. Another explosive play, this time a 64-yard, catch-and-run dime to Tez Johnson got them immediately back into scoring position. Daniels picks up his first professional win in his second career start while the Buccaneers improve to 1-4, miraculously only 1.5-games back of the division lead. Daniels will be a shaky QB2 when the Bucs host the Steelers in Week 6, assuming he gets at least one more start for the injured Baker Mayfield.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ronnie-bel.headline: Cardinals signed WR Ronnie Bell to their practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ronnie-bel.analysis: That makes five practice-squad wideouts for the Cardinals, with Bell joining Zay Jones (who was active last week), Phillip Dorsett (really, that one), James Proche II and Shedrick Jackson. And we’re not sure that those five are any worse than the four that are on their active roster. It’s far from an ideal situation as Arizona tries to evaluate Carson Beck in the desert.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ronnie-bel.headline: Chargers worked out free agent WR JuJu Smith-Schuster on Tuesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ronnie-bel.analysis: Smith-Schuster is touring wide receiver-needy teams, working out with the Chargers Monday after visiting the Vikings on Monday. Several other names also worked out for the Chargers, including former 49ers WR Ronnie Bell and quarterbacks Kyle Trask and Jake Browning. With Trey Lance on injured reserve and several Chargers receivers dealing with injuries, the Chargers are looking for reinforcements.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ronnie-bel.headline: Saints waived/released WR Ronnie Bell, S Elliott Davison, QB Hunter Dekkers, WR Bub Means, TE Zaire Mitchell-Paden, EDGE Garrett Nelson, DL Khalil Saunders,, DE Brien Taylor, T/G Xavier Truss and EDGE Malakai Williams
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ronnie-bel.analysis: Means was a fifth-round pick who showed some potential fantasy intrigue coming out of Pitt in 2024, but it hasn’t worked out. The same can be said for Bell. Both players and Dekkers are candidates for the practice squad. Everyone is a candidate for the practice squad, to be fair.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ronnie-bel.headline: Ronnie Bell was carted off during Tuesday’s scrimmage against the Cowboys with a heat-related issue.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ronnie-bel.analysis: Bell should be able to return to practice in the coming days. The 26-year-old is one of a handful of wideouts competing for the final spots in the Saints’ receiving room.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ronnie-bel.headline: Ronnie Bell left Tuesday’s scrimmage against the Cowboys with an apparent lower-body injury.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ronnie-bel.analysis: Bell had to be carted off the field. The 26-year-old is competing for one of the final spots on the Saints’ roster. Further updates on Bell should be available in the coming days.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ronnie-bel.headline: Saints hosted WRs K.J. Osborn, Mecole Hardman, and Ronnie Bell for workouts.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ronnie-bel.analysis: The Saints are looking to add receiver depth and hosted a trio of wideouts for tryouts Tuesday. Osborn was cut by the Commanders prior to the start of the season while the Packers let Hardman go last month. Bell was also released by the Lions last month. Between the three, the Saints signed Bell to their practice squad.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ronnie-bel.headline: 49ers waived WR Ronnie Bell.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ronnie-bel.analysis: The 49ers selected Bell in the 2023 NFL draft’s seventh round after the former Michigan prospect flashed explosive traits at the NFL combine. Bell was never able to produce consistently as a receiver and likewise struggled to find his footing on special teams. He concludes his 49ers tenure with eight receptions, 90 yards and three touchdowns on 19 targets.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ronnie-bel.headline: 49ers declared S Talanoa Hufanga, QB Joshua Dobbs, CB Darrell Luter Jr., WR Ronnie Bell and OL Ben Bartch inactive for Week 4 against the Patriots.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ronnie-bel.analysis: Hufanga is now out with an ankle injury, one week after making his 2024 debut following his 2023 ACL reconstruction. The 49ers will fortunately have Williams (illness, toe) protecting Brock Purdy’s blindside though. Deebo Samuel Sr. is active as well. He remains a high-ceiling WR1, though the 49ers could opt to rest him late in the game if they establish a comfortable lead, as expected.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ronnie-bel.headline: 49ers declared QB Brandon Allen, DL Alex Barrett, DL T.Y. McGill, LB Jalen Graham, CB Sam Womack, OT Matt Pryor, and WR Ronnie Bell inactive for Super Bowl LVIII.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ronnie-bel.analysis: Rookie wide receiver Ronnie Bell has been the odd man out in the wide receiver rotation throughout the playoffs, a trend that remains for the season’s ultimate game. Both standard elevations from the practice squad, DL Alex Barrett and DL T.Y. McGill are also inactive.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ronnie-bel.headline: 49ers declared WR Ronnie Bell, QB Brandon Allen, WR Willie Snead, LB Jalen Graham, OT Matt Pryor, CB Sam Womack and LB Curtis Robinson inactive for the NFC Championship Game against the Lions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ronnie-bel.analysis: With Deebo Samuel removed on Friday, it’s a quiet injury list for the Niners as they look to return to the Super Bowl. With Samuel in, you can’t get weird with Bell in DFS.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/daniel-car.headline: Dolphins signed K Daniel Carlson to their practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/daniel-car.analysis: With Zane Gonzalez banished on Monday, Carlson projects to be Miami’s kicker this week against the Bills based on the fact that he’s currently the only kicker on either the roster or the practice squad. The 31-year-old went 8-of-12 with the Saints before being waived earlier in November.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/daniel-car.headline: Saints released K Daniel Carlson.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/daniel-car.analysis: Carlson has converted 8-of-12 field goals this season and is 16-for-18 on PATs. The veteran kicker who is known for his big leg has seen all four of his misses come on distances of 50-plus yards, but that was more than enough for the Saints to look in a different direction. Practice squad kicker Charlie Smyth, who converted 12 of his 16 field goal attempts for the Saints last season has a chance to be the next man up when the Saints take on the Browns in Week 9.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/daniel-car.headline: Saints signed K Daniel Carlson, formerly of the Raiders.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/daniel-car.analysis: It would appear that the winner of the kicking competition that took place in training camp between Tanner Brown and Charlie Smyth is the man who wasn’t there. Carlson, who has remained unsigned since his contract with the Raiders expired at the end of last season, is now expected to take over as the Saints’ starting kicker for the season. Currently the 10th-most accurate kicker in NFL history, Carlson converted 22-of-27 field goal attempts last season, with three of his misses coming from 50-plus yards. Carlson still possesses one of the biggest legs in the league and should benefit from kicking in the friendly confines of the Superdome this season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/daniel-car.headline: ESPN’s Adam Schefter reports K Daniel Carlson (groin) will kick in Week 8 against the Lions, barring setback.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/daniel-car.analysis: Carlson was deemed a true game-time decision but appears to be up to the task to kick on Monday night. Groin injuries can be tricky for a kicker, which could influence Josh McDaniels’ tendencies near the outer portions of field goal range tonight. Even so, the Raiders have struggled in the red zone to the tune of a 41.67 percent red zone touchdown rate, meaning Carlson could still find his way into field goal attempts against the stout Lions defense.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/daniel-car.headline: NFL Network’s Tom Pelissero reports Daniel Carlson (groin) “figures to be a game-time decision” for the Raiders’ Week 8 matchup against the Lions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/daniel-car.analysis: The name to know here is James McCourt. McCourt is the kicker the Raiders promoted from the practice squad prior to Monday night’s contest against the Lions. Fantasy managers who weren’t prepared to be without Carlson could conceivably pivot to McCourt if they need a few points from a kicker to push them across the finish line this week. Fantasy managers don’t need to react just yet, as Carlson’s status will be confirmed in the coming hours, but if he can’t go, McCourt is almost certainly available in every league.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/daniel-car.headline: Raiders signed K Daniel Carlson to a four-year, $18.4 million extension through 2025.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/daniel-car.analysis: Carlson is playing 2021 on the restricted free agent tender. After flaming out with the Vikings, Carlson has found a long-term home with Vegas. He’s 27-of-30 (90%) on field goals this season and has missed just two of his 25 extra points. At $4.6 million per year, Carlson is the league’s third-highest paid kicker.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/daniel-car.headline: Raiders re-signed K Daniel Carlson to a one-year, $3.384 million contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/daniel-car.analysis: This is Carlson officially signing his second round restricted free agent tender. Carlson converted 94.3 percent of his 2020 field goal attempts after he was a far worse 73.1 percent in 2019. Carlson was 4-of-4 beyond 50 yards last season as he quietly finished as fantasy’s fourth highest scoring kicker thanks largely to the NFL’s seventh most attempts. He’ll likely be overdrafted in seasonal leagues this season. Coach Jon Gruden evidently believes the 26-year-old is his “kicker of the future.”

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/daniel-car.headline: Raiders extended a second-round tender to restricted free agent K Daniel Carlson.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/daniel-car.analysis: No team is giving up a second-rounder for the kicker. Carlson set the Raiders’ franchise record with 144 points last season. The Mike Zimmer castoff was a stunningly consistent waiver wire pickup in 2020 fantasy leagues, finishing the year as the game’s third highest scoring kicker with a hefty 2.2 field goal attempts per game -- the sixth highest mark in the NFL.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/daniel-car.headline: Raiders re-signed K Daniel Carlson to a one-year, $750,000 contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/daniel-car.analysis: Carlson was an exclusive rights free agent. The 25-year-old was not particularly good last season, converting just 19-of-26 field goal attempts (73.1 percent). He will probably face training camp competition.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/daniel-car.headline: Raiders signed K Daniel Carlson.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/daniel-car.analysis: The Raiders are moving on from Matthew McCrane as they wait on Mike Nugent (hip) to get healthy. A fifth-round rookie out of Auburn, Carlson was cut by the Vikings following a disastrous two-week stint. The Raiders are getting their tank on, and Carlson was good in the SEC, so they are taking a no-risk gamble as they play for draft position and wait on Nugent.

https://www.nbcsports.com/jamree-kromah/.headline: Browns claimed EDGE Jamree Kromah off waivers from the Dolphins.
https://www.nbcsports.com/jamree-kromah/.analysis: Kromah, who played 27 snaps for the Bears in Weeks 6 and 7, managed to get on the field for just two snaps as a Dolphin. Now on his third team of the season, he’s trying to speedrun the Josh Johnson career.

https://www.nbcsports.com/jamree-kromah/.headline: Dolphins claimed EDGE Jamree Kromah off waivers from the Bears.
https://www.nbcsports.com/jamree-kromah/.analysis: You thought you could just sneak this guy through waivers, did you? Well the Miami Dolphins are going to claim him. They’ve got to look busy here as they try to find one or two front seven pieces that will still have jobs in two years. The 26-year-old Kromah is their latest attempt to find one of them.

https://www.nbcsports.com/jamree-kromah/.headline: Patriots declared OLB Anfernee Jennings, TE Jaheim Bell, DE Jamree Kromah, QB Joe Milton III, OT Vederian Lowe, LG Michael Jordan inactive for Week 4 against the 49ers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/jamree-kromah/.analysis: The Patriots’ front-seven is down three starters at this point. It’s an unideal situation facing the 49ers’ vaunted rushing attack. The 49ers’ pass rush should also effectively generate pressure against the Patriots’ problematic offensive line.

https://www.nbcsports.com/jamree-kromah/.headline: Rutgers junior DL Jamree Kromah has entered the transfer portal.
https://www.nbcsports.com/jamree-kromah/.analysis: Kromah (6'4/275) was a three-star prospect from the 2018 recruiting class and was the 99th ranked defensive end in his class per 247Sports’ composite rankings. Kromah spent three seasons at Rutgers, and posted career-highs in 2021 according to Pro Football Focus, when he appeared on 169 defensive snaps while totaling nine tackles and one quarterback pressure on the year. 2021 marked the first season in which he surpassed 100 defensive snaps, as the soon to be fifth-year player will now look to build on his newfound experience elsewhere in 2022.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.headline: Eagles signed RB Jaydon Blue from their practice squad to their active roster.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.analysis: This is the second time Blue has been added to the active roster. He’s played eight offensive snaps this year. Much like the character Blue in Degrassi , with Saquon Barkley healthy and the health of the Eagles running back room trending in a better direction, Blue can be safely cordoned off as a sideplot at this point in fantasy leagues.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.headline: Eagles waived RB Jaydon Blue.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.analysis: Not the first time this season they’ve done this, so we’re expecting a practice squad reunion here. Blue played eight offensive snaps in two weeks on the active roster and does not need to be on your fantasy team at this point.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.headline: Eagles signed RB Jaydon Blue from the practice squad to the active roster.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.analysis: Blue was called up as the replacement for Dameon Pierce, who was placed on injured reserve this week. Saquon Barkley entered Week 7 with a lingering hamstring issue. He then suffered a back injury and was in and out of the lineup for the remainder of the game. With little left to play for, the Eagles may choose to put their star running back on ice for a while. That would leave Blue and Elijah Mitchell as the next men up. Mitchell was the RB3 for Philly in Monday’s game, but he wasn’t signed to the active roster. Our money is on Blue seeing more work this week, though it’s a messy situation at best.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.headline: Eagles placed Dameon Pierce on injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.analysis: Jaydon Blue was signed from their practice squad to the active roster in a corresponding move. Pierce went down with an injury on a kickoff return in the fourth quarter of Monday’s game. The team has not announced the exact injury yet, but Pierce will now miss a minimum of four games. Blue will back up a still-very-injured Saquon Barkley. Barkley returned from his hamstring injury in Week 7, only to suffer a back injury in the process. Blue has an outside chance at starting for the Eagles this week, making him worth a look on waivers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.headline: Eagles waived RB Jaydon Blue.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.analysis: They tacked on a waived/injured listing for Carson Steele, leaving the backfield with just Saquon Barkley and Dameon Pierce on the active roster. Blue did not officially get into a game with the Eagles after signing at the end of August. He’ll look to catch on elsewhere.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.headline: Carson Steele left Week 6 against the Panthers with a shoulder injury.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.analysis: Steele caught a screen pass in the flats and lowered his head to try and run over the defender. He came up holding his shoulder and had to have the shoulder immobilized as he walked into the locker room with his pads off. It had the look of a dislocation, which would mean Dameon Pierce and Jaydon Blue are the only two healthy running backs for the Eagles.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.headline: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) for Week 6 against the Panthers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.analysis: It was pretty clear that this was where things were headed when Barkley was unable to practice on Wednesday and Thursday. We do not yet know Barkley’s official Friday practice participation level, but he was not seen practicing during the portion of practice open to the media. Dameon Pierce, Carson Steele and practice squad player Jaydon Blue will likely split touches this week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.headline: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) did not practice on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.analysis: Barkley is firmly on the wrong side of questionable for his team’s Week 6 game against the Panthers, potentially leaving Dameon Pierce, Carson Steele and practice squad player Jaydon Blue to split touches. Hopefully, reports clarify whether Pierce would handle a sizable workload as the de facto starter.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.headline: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports Tank Bigsby will have core muscle surgery and be placed on injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.analysis: Rapoport reports there are hopes that Bigsby will be back “in six weeks or shorter.” The 24-year-old back will be required to miss at least four games now that he’s headed for an IR stint. With Saquon Barkley (hamstring) also at risk of missing at least one game, third-string RB Will Shipley could be in line for a busy day in Week 5 against the Jaguars. Shipley rushed six times for 23 yards in Sunday’s loss to the Rams, but could be a sneaky option in PPR leagues given his pass-catching profile during his days at Clemson, when he caught 85 passes over three seasons. It also wouldn’t be surprising if Dameon Pierce or Jaydon Blue were promoted off the practice squad and saw early down touches while Shipley serves in more of a third-down role. There’s a lot to figure out here over the next few days.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.headline: ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler reports that the Cowboys “are bracing for an extended absence” after RB Malik Davis suffered a hip injury on Friday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jaydon-blu.analysis: Regarding Davis’ injury, Fowler’s source said simply, “it’s bad.” The Cowboys’ No. 2 running back is undergoing further testing, but we expect them to place him on injured reserve before long. The Cowboys waived RB Jaydon Blue and RB Phil Mafah last month. Blue has since signed with the Eagles’ practice squad. The Cowboys have RB Emari Demercado on the active roster behind RB Javonte Williams. Currently, only RB Israel Abanikanda is on the practice squad in Dallas.

https://www.nbcsports.com/xavier-restrep.headline: Titans promoted WR Xavier Restrepo from the practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/xavier-restrep.analysis: He’ll take Wan’Dale Robinson’s place. Restrepo caught three balls for 31 yards last week as an elevation and is worth monitoring and perhaps even picking up in deeper leagues given how the Titans offense seems to be lurching towards fantasy competence.

https://www.nbcsports.com/xavier-restrep.headline: Xavier Restrepo made the Titans’ initial 53-man roster.
https://www.nbcsports.com/xavier-restrep.analysis: An undrafted free agent out of Miami, Restrepo joined the Titans last season and had 41 yards on three catches over his two active games late in the regular season. Restrepo led the Titans with eight catches and 97 receiving yards this preseason and seemed to surprise Titans beat writers with his ability to get open during training camp. He’ll start the season near the bottom of the team’s depth chart.

https://www.nbcsports.com/xavier-restrep.headline: Titans signed WR Xavier Restrepo to a reserve/future contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/xavier-restrep.analysis: Restrepo had finally gotten elevated just before Thanksgiving before an ankle injury knocked him out for the season. He finished with three catches for 41 yards in two games. The Titans also signed DE David Ebuka Agoha, DB Keydrain Calligan, DT Timmy Horne, LB Nate Lynn, WR Hal Presley III, NT Isaiah Raikes, LB Cam Riley, RB Blake Watson, G Clay Webb and TE Joel Wilson to reserve/future deals.

https://www.nbcsports.com/xavier-restrep.headline: Titans WR Xavier Restrepo (ankle) did not practice on Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/xavier-restrep.analysis: Restrepo’s absence is unsurprising. The rookie wide receiver was carted away from the field after injuring his ankle in the Titans’ Week 13 loss to the Jaguars. Restrepo has caught 3-of-6 targets for 41 yards this season. He does not need to be rostered in re-draft formats.

https://www.nbcsports.com/xavier-restrep.headline: Titans WR Xavier Restrepo (ankle) left Week 13’s loss to the Jaguars and did not return.
https://www.nbcsports.com/xavier-restrep.analysis: Restrepo was called up from the practice squad for his second career game, but was not heavily involved in the offense. He caught his only target for 15 yards late in the blowout loss and was carted off after his ankle was badly injured on the tackle. Restrepo may be looking at a multi-week ankle injury as a result.

https://www.nbcsports.com/xavier-restrep.headline: Making his NFL debut, Titans WR Xavier Restrepo caught 2-of-6 targets for 26 yards in Tennessee’s Week 12 loss to the Seahawks.
https://www.nbcsports.com/xavier-restrep.analysis: Cam Ward’s college teammate, Restrepo was third on the team in targets. He made one of the plays of the day, where he sensed Ward in trouble and got open over the middle of the field as Ward was fading out of bounds. The quarterback made a cross-body throw the wideout was able to track down and catch. Although the 23-year-old UDFA is unlikely to have much of an NFL future, the Titans would be foolish not to at least test the theory down the stretch of this lost season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/xavier-restrep.headline: Titans elevated WR Xavier Restrepo from the practice squad for Week 12 against the Seahawks.
https://www.nbcsports.com/xavier-restrep.analysis: Quarterback Cam Ward’s former collegiate teammate was elevated to the active roster for the first time since signing to the team’s practice squad before the start of the season. Injuries to Calvin Ridley and Elic Ayomanor made it necessary for the team to bring up pass-catching depth, and Restrepo made the most sense. It remains to be seen how much run he will get in his first professional contest.

https://www.nbcsports.com/xavier-restrep.headline: Titans signed WR Xavier Restrepo to their practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/xavier-restrep.analysis: The former Miami (FL) receiver stays with his quarterback, albeit a beat away from actual NFL playing time on the practice squad. The Titans also added WR Mason Kinsey, WR James Proche II, QB Trevor Siemian, OL Andrew Rupcich, DT Isaiah Raikes, DE Ali Gaye, RB Jordan Mims, DB Kendell Brooks, DT Cam Horsley, RB Jermar Jefferson, DB Amani Oruwariye, DE Carlos Watkins, TE Thomas Odukoya and C Corey Levin to their practice squad.

https://www.nbcsports.com/xavier-restrep.headline: Titans waived WR Xavier Restrepo.
https://www.nbcsports.com/xavier-restrep.analysis: Restrepo is a candidate for the Titans practice squad per Adam Schefter and will almost certainly head there if he doesn’t get a 53-man roster spot elsewhere. Restrepo played 44 offensive snaps in the preseason per PFF and finished with a solid 68.7 offensive grade. He may eventually be fantasy-relevant in Tennessee if the receivers in front of him wash out just based on his connection with former college teammate Cam Ward.

https://www.nbcsports.com/xavier-restrep.headline: Team reporter Jim Wyatt observed WR Xavier Restrepo running routes and fielding punts at the Titans’ rookie minicamp on Saturday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/xavier-restrep.analysis: Winning a role on special teams is Restrepo’s ticket to the active roster. The beefy slot receiver could one day earn an offensive role, but for now, establishing himself as a utility player is key. Restrepo delivered middling results, serving as an occasional punt returner during his five-year college career. Overall, he returned 12 punts for 45 yards while forcing eight missed tackles along the way. His 3.8-yard average fails to inspire, but his 0.7 forced missed tackle average is notable.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-m.headline: Ravens released K Harrison Mevis from the practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-m.analysis: He’ll be free to ply his wares again as it appears Riley Patterson has taken hold of the Ravens’ kicking gig. Mevis, 24, will continue to wander the kicking tryout circuit for another chance.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-m.headline: Ravens signed K Harrison Mevis to their practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-m.analysis: The team added Riley Patterson to their active roster yesterday, but both kickers will likely have a chance to earn the job in practice this week. We aren’t expecting great fantasy numbers from either kicker with Lamar Jackson no longer fueling the offense.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-m.headline: Ravens worked out K Harrison Mevis.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-m.analysis: Riley Patterson also worked out for Baltimore. Tyler Loop is on injured reserve and Jake Moody got nabbed off their practice squad, leaving Baltimore without a kicker. One of Mevis or Patterson should get signed in the next few days.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-m.headline: The Athletic’s Nate Atkins reports that Blake Grupe suffered a knee injury in their Week 6 loss to the Cardinals.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-m.analysis: Bringing back Harrison Mevis, whom the Rams waived five days ago, is one option, but it is unclear whether either side wants a reunion. The Rams might want to bring a few special teams contributors aboard while they’re at it. Grupe was injured during a tackle attempt because yet another return had scooted right past the Rams’ special teams coverage unit. The Rams rank outside the top 25 in average kick return yards allowed and average punt return yards allowed. Minimizing kicker tackling attempts in the future is probably a good call.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-m.headline: Rams waived K Harrison Mevis.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-m.analysis: Mevis, I told you six times before, you don’t work here no more. The Thiccer Kicker hit 12-of-13 for the Rams after coming in late last season and 39-of-39 extra points. He doesn’t quite have the distance of some of the league’s best kickers, but we expect him to continue to get chances at 24.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-m.headline: Rams signed K Blake Grupe off the Jets practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-m.analysis: Going 5-for-9 on the season will get you replaced in the modern NFL, as Thiccer Kicker Harrison Mevis is learning. It’s not totally fair, one of those was blocked, but clearly the Rams were not happy with how things were trending. Grupe is a worthwhile pickup in leagues that still use kickers. He went 11-for-11 for the Colts last year after being released by the Saints at midseason.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-m.headline: Rams tendered OL Justin Dedich, K Harrison Mevis, WR Xavier Smith.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-m.analysis: The team will maintain control of three players that surprised in 2025, including “thiccer kicker” Harrison Mevis. The tendering of exclusive rights free agents ties the three to the franchise through the 2026 season considering they are unable to negotiate with other teams. At least for now, it appears as if the Rams will continue forward with Mevis as their place kicker.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-m.headline: Harrison Mevis made his only field-goal attempt in Los Angeles’ NFC Championship loss to the Seahawks.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-m.analysis: Mevis finishes the year 12-of-13 on field goals — missing one against the Seahawks in Week 16 — and hit all 39 of his regular season extra point attempts. He was perfect in the playoffs on five field goals and nine extra-point attempts. The 23-year-old was a find for the Rams and should enter the starting kicker conversation in most fantasy leagues that use kickers in 2026.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-m.headline: Harrison Mevis made 2-of-2 field goals in the Rams’ Week 15 win over the Lions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-m.analysis: He hasn’t missed yet, going 5-for-5 on field-goal attempts and 27-of-27 on extra points. The Rams talked a big game about Joshua Karty eventually getting the job back when they waived him, but Mevis is not giving the former incumbent an inch of space to get active. The Thiccer Kicker will remain a low-end K1 against the Seahawks in Week 16.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-m.headline: Harrison Mevis converted his lone field goal attempt and all six of his extra point attempts in the Rams’ Week 14 win against the Cardinals.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/harrison-m.analysis: Mevis has proven a fine weekly fantasy play thanks to the high-powered Rams offense and the positive game script it creates. He’s made all three of his field goals this season and has yet to miss an extra point. He should be in fantasy lineups next week against the Lions in what should be a high-scoring affair. The Lions have allowed 1.7 field goal tries per game this season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/jordan-phillip.headline: Dolphins placed DT Jordan Phillips (biceps) on injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/jordan-phillip.analysis: He tore his biceps and will miss the remainder of the season. The 2025 fifth-rounder — and notably not the older defensive tackle also named Jordan Phillips — had played 326 snaps this year with a 57.4 PFF grade as an interior lineman.

https://www.nbcsports.com/jordan-phillip.headline: Dolphins selected Maryland DT Jordan Phillips with the No. 143 overall pick in the 2025 NFL Draft.
https://www.nbcsports.com/jordan-phillip.analysis: Celebrated by both NFL.com’s Lance Zierlein and The Athletic’s Dane Brugler for his leadership, work ethic, twitchy athleticism and promising yet raw talent, Phillips makes for an intriguing nose tackle prospect. At 6’2/312, the 20-year-old Phillips has a natural advantage in the battle for pad-level against taller offensive linemen. Through three college seasons, he missed just two tackle attempts while collecting 44 solo tackles and 11 TFLs. Phillips’ raw pass-rushing skills helped him tally 26 career quarterback pressures and a respectable 11.0 percent pass-rush win rate in his final season, but he failed to record a single sack. Should a capable defensive line coach help Phillips harness his skills, Phillips can become an effective three-down player.

https://www.nbcsports.com/jordan-phillip.headline: Tennessee received a verbal commitment from three-star 2022 DL Jordan Phillips.
https://www.nbcsports.com/jordan-phillip.analysis: Phillips (6'2/300) carries a strong 247Sports player grade of 88, as he is considered the 58th defensive lineman and 49th player in Florida from the 2022 prep cycle. He has a whopping 27 offers in hand from several high profile schools like Ole Miss, Michigan, Miami, Iowa State, Georgia and Auburn. He is the seventh player to commit to Tennessee’s 2022 freshman class that currently ranks 12th in the SEC and 48th nationally.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.headline: Bears head coach Ben Johnson said Luther Burden III has cleared the NFL’s concussion protocol.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.analysis: Burden had the Bears’ bye week to recover from the head injury, and it looks like he’ll be a full go for Week 11 against the Saints — barring a setback, of course. Burden has been an elite producer of late, piling up 283 receiving yards over his past three outings while being targeted on a strong 30 percent of his pass routes. Burden over that span has averaged nearly 11 yards after the catch per reception, the third highest mark in the NFL.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.headline: Luther Burden left Week 9’s game against the Buccaneers with an apparent injury. He finished with 7 catches for 97 yards and a touchdown before exiting.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.analysis: Burden fumbled and set up Tampa Bay’s tying score in the fourth quarter after a shot that could have easily been a helmet-to-helmet penalty. The 22-year-old did most of his damage on a 58-yard score that gave Chicago a 14-0 lead. Burden will assuredly undergo concussion testing, but it’s worth noting the Bears don’t play again until Week 11 against the Lions because of a bye.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.headline: Luther Burden caught 7-of-9 targets for 56 yards and a touchdown in the Bears’ Week 8 win over the Seahawks.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.analysis: Burden’s opening drive score was the first touchdown surrendered by the Seahawks on an opening possession in the previous 26 games, finishing tied with tight end Colston Loveland for the team lead in targets while catching the only passing score from quarterback Caleb Williams. He continues to operate as the team’s top option through the air in a role that is most malleable, which can either be concentrated on the short areas against zone or extended in the vertical against man. Burden is a WR2 in a pass-funnel matchup against the Buccaneers in Week 9.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.headline: Luther Burden caught all four targets for 130 yards and a touchdown in the Bears’ Week 7 win over the Patriots, adding seven yards on one carry.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.analysis: Burden erupted on the scene with a 58-yard, catch-and-run reception on a crosser in the first quarter to set up a four-yard score for D’Andre Swift. He would tack on another 24 yards and his touchdown late in the second quarter to push him over the century mark in yards on an improbable touchdown reception, taking a quick screen to the house on third-and-17 with only 14 seconds remaining before the break. Burden would largely fall victim to a more reserved offensive stance after the Bears pushed their lead to 13 points on their first possession of the second half, adding just one additional reception in the final 30 minutes of play. That matters not to fantasy managers that had been waiting for a marquee performance from a player they chased up draft boards this summer. Burden appears to be heating up now further removed from the offseason injury he carried into the start of the regular season and can continue to be started as an upside WR2 ahead of a difficult matchup against the Seahawks in Week 8.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.headline: Luther Burden III caught all eight of his targets for 95 yards in the Bears’ Week 6 win against the Falcons.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.analysis: With Caleb Williams back from a hamstring injury, Burden led the Bears with eight targets and a season-high 95 yards, mostly on short over-the-middle passes from Williams. Burden’s long play was a 25-yard catch and run. That he ran a route on just 19 of the Bears’ 45 drop backs is something of a concern going forward. With that little route involvement, Burden will have to be hyper efficient if he’s going to be a WR2/3 in fantasy formats. He should remain in lineups next week against the Patriots.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.headline: Luther Burden III caught 4-of-6 targets for 47 yards in the Bears’ Week 5 loss to the Packers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.analysis: Burden “led” the Bears in receiving, but the fact that 47 yards was the team’s high-water mark tells you all you need to know about their offensive effectiveness this afternoon. Today was actually the first time in three games without Caleb Williams that Burden finished under 60 yards receiving, but he is still in dire need of his starting quarterback’s return. It appears that will be Week 6 against the Falcons, keeping Burden in the low-end WR2 mix despite his lack of spiked weeks through the season’s first five contests.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.headline: Luther Burden III caught 4-of-6 targets for 63 yards in the Bears’ Week 4 win against the Jets, adding one rush for 11 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.analysis: It was a fine outing for Burden after he showed signs of life in Week 3’s win over the Eagles. Burden was second on the team in targets, trailing Rome Odunze’s seven looks from Tyson Bagent. He ran a few more pass routes than Kalif Raymond, who had two grabs for six yards. Chicago operating as a run-first team is going to necessarily limit Burden’s opportunities, but he should suffice as a WR3/4 in the coming weeks. That includes next week against a middling Green Bay secondary.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.headline: Luther Burden caught 7-of-11 targets for 61 yards and a touchdown in the Bears’ Week 3 win over the Eagles, adding seven yards on one carry.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.analysis: Burden got the scoring started with a shovel-pass touchdown on the first possession of the game and continued to be the primary engine of the offense on a night the team was led by veteran journeyman Case Keenum. Head coach Ben Johnson handily outmatched his counterpart in Sean Mannion, keeping the offense in rhythm and unpredictable throughout. Burden should continue to improve upon his early-season returns for fantasy managers that chased him up draft boards this offseason, particularly once Caleb Williams returns to the starting roster in a few weeks. In the meantime, treat Burden as an upside WR2 ahead of a Week 4 meeting with the Jets in Chicago.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.headline: Luther Burden caught 3-of-7 targets for 32 yards in the Bears’ Week 2 loss to the Vikings.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.analysis: For the second straight week, Burden was out-produced by Kalif Raymond, who again led the receiver corps in production. D’Andre Swift “led” the entire team in receiving with five receptions for 54 scoreless yards. Burden is now sitting on eight catches for 95 yards through two weeks. It’s not the worst start anyone has ever seen, but fantasy managers were expecting better. It might not be coming in Week 3 if Caleb Williams’ hamstring injury costs him time against the Eagles, which seems highly likely. We are trying not to overreact to small-sample sizes, but Burden is definitely now more of a WR3 than WR2 heading into next Monday’s contest. That, of course, should still have him in most fantasy lineups.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.headline: Luther Burden caught all five of his targets for 63 yards in the Bears’ Week 1 win against the Panthers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/luther-bur.analysis: Burden overcame a first quarter fumble on a bubble screen to finish second on the team in targets behind Kalif Raymond, who saw nine looks from Caleb Williams, just as everyone had predicted. While Burden’s 17 percent targets per route run was well below his 2025 rate, he should be more involved going forward in a Bears offense that might be trying to break the NFL’s single season scoring record, as head coach Ben Johnson mentioned in an August interview. Burden will be a top-30 PPR option next week against the Vikings.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/azeez-al-s.headline: Texans placed Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) on injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/azeez-al-s.analysis: Al-Shaair has been playing through a serious groin issue for weeks. He was sidelined in Week 10 against the Browns and will now miss extended time. The Houston Chronicle’s Jonathan M. Alexander said Al-Shaair is “likely to miss more than four games but has not been ruled out for the season.” The Texans this season have allowed the 13th highest EPA per play and the tenth lowest offensive success rate. Their defense will be a little more vulnerable with Al-Shaair sidelined.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/azeez-al-s.headline: Azeez Al-Shaair left Houston’s Week 6 game against the Jaguars to be evaluated for a concussion.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/azeez-al-s.analysis: The Jaguars have been able to impose their will on the Texans in the run game in the first half, and this won’t help matters. Al-Shaair left after Jacksonville scored their first touchdown in the second quarter and was spotted walking to the locker room. He returned towards the beginning of the second half.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/azeez-al-s.headline: Texans declared LB Azeez Al-Shaair, DE Chris Braswell, OG Febechi Nwaiwu, OT Nate Thomas, and TE Marlin Klein inactive for Week 4 against the Cowboys.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/azeez-al-s.analysis: The Texans are at near full strength and welcome back wide receiver Nico Collins, who was removed from the team’s injury report on Friday. Collins’ return comes at a time where Houston is seeking its first win of the season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/azeez-al-s.headline: Texans signed LB Azeez Al-Shaair to a three-year, $54 million contract extension.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/azeez-al-s.analysis: Al-Shaair was set to play out the final year of his current contract this season. Instead, Houston keeps him locked in with a long-term deal. Al-Shaair has been with the Texans for two years, starting all 27 regular season games he has been active for. In 2025, Al-Shaair totaled two interceptions, one forced fumble, and a team-high 103 combined tackles.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/azeez-al-s.headline: Fort Worth Star-Telegram’s Nick Harris reports that the Cowboys are discussing potential trades for Dolphins LB Jordyn Brooks and Texans LB Azeez Al-Shaair.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/azeez-al-s.analysis: Harris isn’t the only reporter who believes that the Cowboys are still on the hunt for new defenders. In a report from earlier today, ESPN’s Todd Archer mentions Brooks and Al-Shaair as well, while also bringing up Steelers LB Patrick Queen as a possibility. Harris disagrees on the latter player, saying on social media that the Cowboys have “pivoted off Queen,” though he believes the inside linebacker position “gets addressed in the trade market.” In a mock draft published today, Harris links LSU CB Mansoor Delane to the Cowboys at pick No. 12 and Clemson EDGE T.J. Parker at pick No. 20. Brooks totaled 125 solo tackles and 19 TFLs. Al-Shaair totaled 74 solo tackles and five TFLs. Stay tuned.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/azeez-al-s.headline: Texans CB Kamari Lassiter (ankle/knee) won’t play in Houston’s Week 18 game against the Colts.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/azeez-al-s.analysis: That will unlock some of Indianapolis’ wideout options should Riley Leonard be able to aim the ball in their direction. Derek Stingley (oblique) is off the injury report, as is linebacker Azeez Al-Shaair. It doesn’t sound like Lassiter would be resting if this were a win-and-in game for the Texans.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/azeez-al-s.headline: Texans CB Kamari Lassiter (ankle/knee) was not seen practicing on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/azeez-al-s.analysis: Lassiter got hurt in Week 17 against the Chargers, but was able to return later in the game. Thus far, he has missed both practices in Week 18. Fellow starting CB Derek Stingley (oblique) resumed practicing today, as did LB Azeez Al-Shaair (knee/shoulder). The Texans (11-5) have secured a playoff spot, yet trail the Jaguars (12-4) in the AFC South standings. If the Jaguars lose to the Titans this week, the Texans can steal the division title by beating the Colts. The outcome seems unlikely.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/azeez-al-s.headline: Texans CB Derek Stingley (oblique) is questionable for Houston’s Week 16 game against the Raiders.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/azeez-al-s.analysis: He got in a limited session to get on to the questionable line after missing Wednesday and Thursday practice. Azeez Al-Shaair was limited on Thursday, but did not participate in Wednesday or Friday practice for the Texans. Both players should be considered true question marks for Week 16’s action against the Raiders.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/azeez-al-s.headline: Texans restructured LB Azeez Al-Shaair’s contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/azeez-al-s.analysis: The restructuring of Al-Shaair freed up $6.26 million in cap space for the upcoming season. Al-Shaair is perhaps most known for his illegal hit on Trevor Lawrence that saw the league levy a three-game suspension against him. Al-Shaair joined the Texans on a three-year, $34 million deal and is under contract through 2026. Last season he totaled 70 tackles and two sacks in 11 games while earning a PFF defensive grade of 68.9.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/azeez-al-s.headline: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports Joe Mixon (ankle) will play in the Texans’ Divisional Round against the Chiefs.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/azeez-al-s.analysis: Rapoport reports that linebacker Azeez Al-Shaair (knee) will also play after being listed as questionable on Friday. Mixon suffered his ankle injury on Wednesday and was a DNP on Thursday, so we don’t know much about the severity of his injury other than it’s not believed to be “a major injury,” according to a report from Friday. It sounds like the Texans will be able to lean on Mixon in his normal role on Saturday as the Texans hope to top the Chiefs and make a trip to the AFC Championship Game next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aidan-hutc.headline: Aidan Hutchinson (ACL) will miss the remainder of the season.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aidan-hutc.analysis: Lions head coach Dan Campbell confirmed the news Tuesday morning during a radio interview. Hutchinson went down last week against the Patriots while celebrating a sack. His knee buckled and Hutchinson crumbled tot he turf in pain. He is just the latest NFL player to injure himself while celebrating on the field. Without Hutchinson, Detroit’s defense might struggle to pressure the passer. Headed into Week 11 they rank second in pressure rate and 10th in quick pressure rate. Hutchinson will end his 2026 season with six sacks and six tackles for loss.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aidan-hutc.headline: ESPN’s Adam Schefter reports Aidan Hutchinson (knee) tore his ACL and will miss the rest of the season.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aidan-hutc.analysis: This was expected based on what we’d been hearing but this is official confirmation that the Lions have lost their best pass rusher for the remainder of the season. Hutchinson, 26, may have a rough time making it back for the start of the 2027 season based on the timing of this injury. As has become the norm in this era, the Lions defense just can’t seem to have all their best players be healthy at the right time.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aidan-hutc.headline: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports the Lions believe Aidan Hutchinson suffered a torn ACL in Week 10’s win over the Patriots.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aidan-hutc.analysis: Hutchinson will have an MRI to confirm, but things have been trending in this direction ever since it was reported on Sunday night that the team was “very concerned” about the star pass-rusher’s injury. Hutchinson landed awkwardly on a play when he jumped to celebrate a sack on Drake Maye and did not return to the field. If the worst is confirmed, it would be Hutchinson’s second season-ending injury since 2024.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aidan-hutc.headline: NBC Sports’ Pro Football Talk’s Mike Florio reports that Aidan Hutchinson (knee) will undergo imaging, and the Lions are “very concerned.”
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aidan-hutc.analysis: Earlier today, NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reported that Hutchinson is expected to be out “for the foreseeable future.” Although nothing is concrete yet, Florio’s report generally supports Rapoport’s sentiment. The Lions precariously sit atop the NFC North at 7-2. Both the Vikings and Bears share that record, while the Packers sit in fourth at 6-4.
