But your 11, whether you’re playing really well or not playing well at all, it’s always going to change a little bit.” The Raiders through Week 8 rank dead last in EPA per rush and second to last in rushing success rate. Jeanty should remain viable as long as he’s the team’s primary pass catcher out of the backfield. Jeanty ranks fifth among all RBs in expected fantasy points per game.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ashton-jea.headline: Ashton Jeanty rushed two times for nine yards in the Raiders’ Week 8 win over the Jets, adding three receptions for 64 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ashton-jea.analysis: Jeanty was benched as the Raiders’ early-down back, getting out-carried 25-2 by Mike Washington Jr. For his part, Washington was not effective, churning up just 3.3 yards per carry and getting stoned on a bevy of goal-line handles. Speaking afterward, coach Klint Kubiak said the move was his call but that "(Jeanty) is still going to be a big part of our team.” Jeanty made waves during the week when he said the Jets could not tackle. Rather than let the struggling second-year back prove his theory on the field, the Raiders made the takedown themselves for the Jets. While it’s clear Jeanty is now in a true timeshare, we do also take Kubiak at his word that Jeanty will remain a “big part” of the team, almost certainly with double-digit carries more weeks than not. The question is if he can keep catching enough passes to hold RB2 status. Washington is now the preferred short-yardage back, but his failures in Sunday’s highest-leverage spots could keep the door ajar for Jeanty.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ashton-jea.headline: Ashton Jeanty had eight rushes for 15 yards in the Raiders’ Week 7 loss to the Rams, adding eight catches for 61 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ashton-jea.analysis: Among the least efficient rushers in the game, Jeanty again struggled to get anything going on the ground behind a middling Vegas offensive line. He did almost all of his damage through the air, turning eight targets into 61 yards and a late score in garbage time. He ran a route on 20 of the team’s 35 drop backs against the Rams and ranked second among Raiders pass catchers in targets. Mike Washington had six carries on the day. Jeanty, with at least six targets in six of his seven games this season, can maintain RB2 status as long as he’s catching passes out of the backfield. He gets the Jets in Week 8.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ashton-jea.headline: Mike Washington (foot/back) did not practice on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ashton-jea.analysis: Dang. This suggests Washington suffered one or both injuries yesterday in practice. He is firmly in the questionable camp and may have only a long shot at suiting up in Week 7 against the Rams. Without him, Ashton Jeanty should handle a solid workload. Dylan Laube could end up serving as the No. 2 running back.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ashton-jea.headline: Ashton Jeanty rushed 10 times for 22 yards and a touchdown in the Raiders’ Week 6 loss to the Bills, adding four receptions for 36 additional yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ashton-jea.analysis: Jeanty, who is dealing with a foot/ankle injury, wasn’t effective on the ground, but that didn’t stop him from scoring his first rushing touchdown of the season. Jeanty punched in a one-yard score in the first quarter of Sunday’s game to give the Raiders an early 7-3 lead, but averaged a disappointing 2.2 YPC overall. He did manage a solid 4-36-0 receiving line on six targets, with two of his four receptions coming on the Raiders’ third drive of the game. Jeanty appeared on 15 more snaps than Mike Washington and out-touched him 14 to 10. While he continues to struggle from an efficiency standpoint, Jeanty’s volume will make him a low-end RB1 next week against the Rams.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ashton-jea.headline: Ashton Jeanty (foot) was removed from the injury report and will play in Week 6 against the Bills.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ashton-jea.analysis: The Raiders’ starting running back is good to go for what should be a fantasy-friendly game environment. The Raiders encouragingly stopped listing Jeanty with an ankle injury this week. Hopefully, his remaining plantar fasciitis issue subsides before long as well. Jeanty is a low-end RB1 in Week 6.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ashton-jea.headline: Ashton Jeanty (foot) said he is feeling “great” and “ready to go” for Week 6 against the Bills.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/ashton-jea.analysis: The quotes read a tad bit more enthusiastically than Jeanty did while speaking to media members at his locker, but this is still good to hear. Jeanty has been dealing with an ankle injury for a long time, but the team took that injury off the weekly practice report this week. He is now listed only with the foot injury after experiencing “a flare-up of plantar fasciitis” last Friday. Jeanty is a low-end RB1 against the Bills this week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/coleman-sh.headline: Coleman Shelton did not return to the Rams’ Week 10 win over the Cardinals after suffering a hamstring injury in the second quarter.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/coleman-sh.analysis: Shelton and his backup, Dylan McMahon (knee), both suffered injuries today, causing the Rams to shuffle their offensive line personnel. The Rams are on bye in Week 11. Hopefully at least one of them can return in time for the Rams’ Week 12 game against the Packers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/coleman-sh.headline: Rams agreed to terms with C Coleman Shelton, formerly of the Bears, on a two-year contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/coleman-sh.analysis: Shelton returns to the Rams, where he played from 2019-2023. He spent last season with the Bears, making 17 starts and allowing three sacks. The Bears chose to revamp their offensive line, leaving Shelton looking elsewhere in free agency. He reunites with the Rams on a two-year deal and will be in the mix to start after starting 30 games for Los Angeles from 2022-2023.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/coleman-sh.headline: Bears agreed to terms with C Coleman Shelton, formerly of the Rams, on a one-year contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/coleman-sh.analysis: A former undrafted free agent, Shelton made 30 starts on the pivot over the past two seasons in Los Angeles. He’s an upgrade on Lucas Patrick, but not a particularly big one in Pro Football Focus’ ratings are to be believed. Shelton is far stronger in the run game than as a pass blocker.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/coleman-sh.headline: Rams re-signed G/C Coleman Shelton to a two-year contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/coleman-sh.analysis: A longtime reserve, Shelton became a 13-game starter along the Rams’ injury-ruined offensive last season, spending time at both guard and center. He held his own, though not to the degree he should be considered a no-brainer 2023 starter. He will simply be part of the mix along the interior.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/coleman-sh.headline: Rams coach Sean McVay said C Coleman Shelton (ankle) will miss 4-to-6 weeks.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/coleman-sh.analysis: Jeremiah Kolone played center in Shelton’s absence on Sunday and the 49ers were able to blitz the Rams with impunity despite that being the surest way to get shredded by Matthew Stafford last season. The mounting injuries on the offensive line are, along with the inability to get Allen Robinson involved, big reasons why the Rams offense has been parked for much of 2022.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/coleman-sh.headline: Rams C Coleman Shelton exited Week 4 against the 49ers with an ankle injury and will not return.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/coleman-sh.analysis: Shelton, the Rams’ starting right guard, has been forced to play center the last three weeks because Brian Allen needed knee surgery after Week 1. Shelton tried to play the Rams’ second drive, but it didn’t go well, and he was ruled out. Jeremiah Kolone is now in the game. Los Angeles’ line has been wrecked by offseason departures and in-season injuries.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/coleman-sh.headline: Rams re-signed OG Coleman Shelton to a two-year contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/coleman-sh.analysis: The Rams have made their offensive line a point of emphasis to start free agency, re-signing three players on the first day. Shelton is a backup on the interior but did see action in two spot-starts last year. He will likely remain a backup in 2022 but brings some versatility and depth to the table.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/coleman-sh.headline: Rams re-signed OG Coleman Shelton and LB Travin Howard to one-year contracts.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/coleman-sh.analysis: Both players were exclusive rights free agents. Shelton played 75 2020 snaps. Howard missed the entire season with a torn meniscus.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Fernando Mendoza completed 17-of-29 attempts for 143 yards in the Raiders’ Week 10 loss to the Seahawks, adding six rushes for 22 yards and a touchdown.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Mendoza was thrown directly into the meat grinder of the elite Seahawks defense and lost his superstar tight end, Brock Bowers, to a potentially serious ankle injury in the first quarter. After a first quarter rushing score on a draw play, Mendoza and the Raiders couldn’t get anything going against Seattle. Mendoza, who was sacked six times, posted a -6.8 EPA while Drew Lock had an EPA of 7. Mendoza was about 7 percent under his expected completion rate. Things won’t get much easier for the 2026 No. 1 overall pick in Week 11 when the Raiders take on the Broncos. Mendoza for now is strictly a superflex option.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports the Raiders planned to start Fernando Mendoza “in the next few weeks” even if Kirk Cousins had not been traded.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: With games against the Seahawks and Broncos on tap for Mendoza’s first two starts, the Raiders may have wanted to throw Cousins to the wolves for those games before getting the No. 1 overall pick under center against Cleveland. Instead, the Vikings offered Vegas a third-round pick for Cousins and the Raiders couldn’t say no. Mendoza will make his first NFL start at home versus Seattle today. We expect him to be in the QB2 mix at some point this year, but it might take a few weeks given Vegas’s tough schedule.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: ESPN’s Adam Schefter reports Fernando Mendoza will take over as Raiders starter following the trade of Kirk Cousins to Minnesota.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: We’re sure we’ll get something more official from the team once Klint Kubiak has a press conference, but this is the obvious move. The No. 1 overall pick will face a gauntlet in his first three games, starting with the defending champion Seahawks in Week 10. It’s not an immediate re-draft add situations outside of deep leagues, but Mendoza could eventually factor into the re-draft formula this season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Vikings acquired QB Kirk Cousins from the Raiders for a 2027 third-round pick.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: And where did that bring you? Back to me. Cousins will likely take over as Minnesota’s starting quarterback in the near future, if not immediately. When that happens, Kyler Murray will head back to the bench for a second straight season — he’s droppable in most leagues at this point. Fernando Mendoza will take over as starting quarterback for the Raiders. Mendoza is best approached cautiously at this point in fantasy leagues. Cousins’ value likely remains stagnant — Klint Kubiak was already getting quite a bit out of him — but he provides the Vikings with a better floor at quarterback than what they were getting so it’s obvious after watching Carson Wentz play last night why this is happening.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: ESPN’s Adam Schefter reports the Raiders plan to start Kirk Cousins “as long as possible.”
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Schefter added that the team does not feel their current four-game losing streak is the fault of Cousins. He threw for nine touchdowns in the first three games, all of which the Raiders won. Cousins has just seven touchdowns over his past four outings, though he has only thrown two interceptions and taken just five sacks during that stretch. The Raiders are probably right to lay the blame elsewhere. Still, No. 1 overall pick Fernando Mendoza is waiting in the wings. He is the future of the franchise, and his time grows closer with every Raiders loss. Vegas takes on the Jets this week. They then get a gauntlet of San Francisco, Seattle, and Denver. A 0-3 run that late in the season would likely spell the end of Cousins as their starter.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak said “Kirk Cousins is our quarterback,” when asked about the possibility of making a change at QB ahead of Week 8.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Rather than let any speculation linger, Kubiak was quick to shut down any idea of a switch at quarterback heading into Week 8’s game against the Jets. Kubiak said, “There is no controversy” at quarterback at this time, while also adding that “Fernando [Mendoza] is going to play football” at some point this season. Kubiak said the team does not have a timeline for when Mendoza could eventually make a start, and said Cousins continues to play well despite the team’s recent struggles. Cousins will be firmly on the streaming radar this week against a Jets team that just allowed 28 points to the Dolphins.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Raiders’ head coach Klint Kubiak said the team is “thinking about everything” in regards to the team’s QB situation after Week 7’s loss to the Rams.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: Kubiak was asked about the possibility of switching from Kirk Cousins to rookie No. 1 overall pick Fernando Mendoza, and said the team is considering “everything” while also making it sound like their struggles were more of a team issue. Cousins struggled in the early part of Sunday’s loss to the Rams, but managed some late touchdowns in garbage time to save his stat line. If the Raiders are considering a switch, it’s possible we’ll learn their decision by Wednesday, when they begin preparing for their Week 8 game against the Jets.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said Kirk Cousins is the starter “but if Fernando [Mendoza]'s number is called we have confidence in him.”
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: No real surprise after Mendoza’s mop-up appearance in Week 5. It doesn’t appear that he’s taken a major step towards unseating Cousins — who has played well — just yet. But it remains a reasonable bet to happen in the near future.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Fernando Mendoza completed 6-of-8 passes for 48 yards in relief of Kirk Cousins in Las Vegas’ Week 5 loss to the Patriots.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: This doesn’t necessarily mean that Mendoza is going to take the reins this week; we expect Cousins to continue starting even if Raiders coach Klint Kubiak didn’t affirmatively get ahead of the situation in Sunday’s post-game. But Mendoza looked reasonable and this will obviously be something that will bubble up eventually. No. 1 overall picks don’t typically stay on benches too long.

https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.headline: Raiders named Kirk Cousins as the team’s Week 1 starter.
https://www.nbcsports.com/college-footba.analysis: With input from Tom Brady, head coach Klint Kubiak will put the 38-year-old Cousins under center for the season opener against the Dolphins. Fernando Mendoza, the No. 1 pick in the 2026 NFL Draft, will serve as Cousins’ backup. How long this arrangement will last is anyone’s guess. A good start to the regular season could delay Mendoza’s first NFL start for a couple months but he’s almost certain to take over as the Vegas starter at some point in 2026. Mendoza should be stashed in most superflex formats and Cousins profiles as a decent QB2 in such formats for Week 1.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.headline: Tyler Allgeier rushed five times for 14 yards in the Cardinals’ Week 10 loss to the Rams.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.analysis: The Cardinals’ coaching staff gave Allgeier the chance to be the team’s lead rusher today. He botched it, eventually ceding carries to Bam Knight late in the game. Knight barely outplayed him. Allgeier failed to catch his lone target. He is just a FLEX option next week against the Chiefs.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.headline: Bam Knight will play in Week 10 against the Rams after clearing concussion protocol.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.analysis: After being upgraded to a full participant on Thursday, Knight is officially off of the injury report and good to go for Sunday’s game against the Rams. Both Knight and Tyler Allgeier are expected to factor heavily into the Cardinals’ running game this weekend, especially with Carson Beck making his first career start with a depleted receiving corps. Both Knight and Allgeier will be fringe RB3/Flex plays in a game that could prove tough for the Cardinals’ banged-up offense.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.headline: Tyler Allgeier rushed 17 times for 46 yards in the Cardinals’ Week 9 loss to the Seahawks, gaining zero additional yards on two receptions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.analysis: In what was the first game as the clear starter for the Cardinals in the absence of both Jeremiyah Love and Bam Knight, Allgeier was contained to only 2.7 yards per carry as the offense managed under 200 yards of total offense against the stingy Seattle defense. Fantasy managers that were quick to scoop Allgeier off of waivers heading into Week 9 are surely to be disappointed with the returns, particularly considering Knight had largely outperformed the former prior to missing Week 9 with a concussion. Expect a near-even split backfield once Knight returns, which appears likely to be in Week 10 when the Cardinals face another difficult test in the Rams.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.headline: Tyler Allgeier rushed 11 times for 147 yards and a touchdown in Arizona’s Week 8 win over the Cowboys, adding five catches for 44 yards and an additional touchdown.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.analysis: Allgeier was given reign of the backfield in the second half after Bam Knight (concussion) was ruled out and Jeremiyah Love (ankle) left early in the first half. He decided to take advantage of it with runs of 63 yards (for a score) and 52 yards to set up a very nice sideline tightrope touchdown on a reception. Allgeier was the only healthy back for the Cardinals at this point in the game and this isn’t the kind of performance we’ll see repeated, but he definitely could step in to an expanded role in Week 9 given the injuries around him. If he was dropped in your league, he’s a worthwhile waiver wire consideration.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.headline: Tyler Allgeier (toe) was removed from the injury report and will play in Week 8 against the Cowboys.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.analysis: Allgeier saw a steady progression in practice throughout the week, starting off with a “DNP” before upgrading in each subsequent session, culminating in a full practice Friday. He will be available to form a likely three-headed timeshare with Jeremiyah Love and Bam Knight against the Cowboys and likely does not warrant fantasy consideration.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.headline: Tyler Allgeier (toe) was a limited participant during Thursday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.analysis: Allgeier was able to get a bump up after a DNP for Wednesday. It appears to just be a case of rest for the 26-year-old, but fantasy managers who will consider Allgeier for Week 8 against the Cowboys if Jeremiyah Love (ankle) can’t go — Love was also limited Thursday — should keep an eye on Friday’s designation.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.headline: Tyler Allgeier (toe) did not practice Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.analysis: Allgeier popped up on the injury report with a toe issue as rookie Jeremiyah Love (ankle) returned to practice in a limited fashion. Though we don’t know the severity of Allgeier’s injury, it may be worth keeping Bam Knight rostered despite Love’s return. If Allgeier cannot play in Week 8 against the Cowboys, Knight will get another week of fantasy viability.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.headline: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) will be limited on Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.analysis: We were hoping to see Love practice in full after taking two weeks off. While today’s limited session puts him on track to play in Week 8 against the Cowboys, Bam Knight and Tyler Allgeier are still worth stashing on benches, just in case. The Cardinals are finally handling Love’s recovery patiently, after giving him far too many touches early in the preseason.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.headline: Tyler Allgeier rushed eight times for 19 yards in the Cardinals’ Week 7 loss to the Broncos, adding three catches for 30 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.analysis: Allgeier only saw one more carry than Bam Knight. Both backs caught three passes, but Knight was the recipient of five targets. Through two Jeremiyah Love absences, Allgeier has 26 carries for 57 yards. He’s barely playing ahead of Knight and has been the far less efficient member of the backfield. Knight has 128 yards on four fewer attempts. Even if Love is out again next week, Allgeier will barely crack the RB3 ranks versus Dallas.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.headline: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur said Tyler Allgeier is “always” going to serve as a complementary running back.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tyler-allg.analysis: LaFleur really laid it all out there at today’s press conference, saying Allgeier “is always going to complement that next guy” when the starter is out. He adds that Allgeier is “extremely smart” and can be trusted in pass protection and short-yardage situations on third down. While Allgeier “can” do what the Cardinals need him to do on first and second down, LaFleur said Bam Knight will take “a lot” of that work with Jeremiyah Love (ankle) sidelined. LaFleur closed by saying he does not think any of these running backs can hold up in a full-time role over the course of the season. Allgeier handled a hefty 19 touches in this complementary role last week. He can be started as a high-volume FLEX with touchdown-based upside against the Broncos.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zach-charb.headline: Zach Charbonnet had 20 rushes for 94 yards in the Seahawks’ Week 10 win against the Raiders.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zach-charb.analysis: Charbonnet again led the Seattle backfield in another run-heavy outing. Jadarian Price, however, scored a touchdown on his nine rushing attempts. Charbonnet rumbled for a few impressive, tough runs against a miserable Raiders defense that appeared worn down in the second half. His long play came on a 24-yard rush in the second half. Though Charbonnet led the Seahawks backfield in routes, he did not see a target. When the Seahawks return from bye in Week 12, Charbonnet will profile as a high-floor RB2 option.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zach-charb.headline: Jadarian Price had nine rushes for 36 yards and a touchdown in the Seahawks’ Week 10 win against the Raiders, adding one catch for eight yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zach-charb.analysis: It was Price’s first touchdown of the season, and it came on a 12-yard rush around the left edge against a Vegas run defense that has collapsed in recent weeks. Zach Charbonnet, meanwhile, led the backfield with 20 carries for 94 scoreless yards. Charbonnet ran 15 routes to seven routes for Price. When the Seahawks return from bye in Week 12, Price will be a deep league flex option in the run-first Seattle offense.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zach-charb.headline: Zach Charbonnet rushed 16 times for 77 yards in the Seahawks’ Week 9 win over the Cardinals, adding nine yards on one reception.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zach-charb.analysis: Charbonnet served as the clear lead back against an inferior Cardinals team, handling 16 carries and two targets to the nine carries and four targets of rookie Jadarian Price. The roughly 60-40 split between the two is likely closer to what to expect for the remainder of the season now that Charbonnet has another game under his belt coming off the 2025 torn ACL. The fantasy returns could be much greater against arguably the worst defense in the league at present, with Charbonnet inching closer to weekly FLEX status ahead of a Week 10 meeting with the Raiders.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zach-charb.headline: Zach Charbonnet rushed six times for 23 yards in the Seahawks’ Week 8 loss to the Bears, adding six yards on three receptions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zach-charb.analysis: Charbonnet drew the start but saw four fewer opportunities than rookie Jadarian Price, the latter of whom led the team in rush yards and touches. Expect the two to continue operating in a near-even timeshare moving forward, leaving Charbonnet in shaky FLEX territory ahead of a Week 9 meeting with the Cardinals.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zach-charb.headline: Zach Charbonnet (knee) and Jadarian Price (chest) are active for Week 8 against the Bears.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zach-charb.analysis: Charbonnet makes his season debut after a suffering a torn ACL late in the 2025 season while Price returns from short-term injure reserve due to a chest injury. Emmanuel Wilson and George Holani had held down the backfield in the absence of the two top backs, leaving an uncertain situation regarding expected backfield utilization when the Seahawks take on the Bears in a marquee matchup. Inactive for the Seahawks are QB Drew Lock, LB Uchenna Nwosu, WR Rashid Shaheed, RB Velus Jones Jr., OT Charles Cross, G Beau Stephens, and NT Brandon Pili.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zach-charb.headline: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports the Seahawks plan to activate Jadarian Price from injured reserve and that he will play in Week 8 against the Bears.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zach-charb.analysis: Price and Zach Charbonnet will both make their returns from injured reserve tonight, putting the Seahawks’ backfield at full strength heading into a pivotal NFC matchup. It’s hard to know how the touches will be spread out in this one, which makes both backs hard to trust on Monday night against the Bears. Price averaged 11.5 carries per game in his two full games played this season, but Charbonnet should eat into that somewhat. Fantasy managers looking to play either Seattle running back in this one should temper expectations until we have more data to go on in the coming weeks.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zach-charb.headline: Zach Charbonnet (knee) is expected to be active for Week 8 against the Bears.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zach-charb.analysis: The team has yet to activate Charbonnet from injured reserve but removed him from the injury report Saturday, leaving only the procedural step in the way of his season debut. He likely returns to a limited role as the team manages his reps in his first game since tearing his ACL in 2025. Rookie Jadarian price is also expected to play after being removed from the injury report. He, too, will need to be activated from injured reserve.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zach-charb.headline: Zach Charbonnet (knee) was downgraded to “limited” for Friday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zach-charb.analysis: It’s not particularly concerning — this is probably part of a pre-established practice plan as Charbonnet completes his injury comeback — but Jadarian Price’s Friday return to full practice certainly has our attention. Now even if Charbonnet does manage to make his 2026 debut on Monday evening against the Bears, he could have even more company in Seattle’s crowded backfield. Both backs returning would make all three of Charbonnet, Price and Emanuel Wilson shaky FLEX plays. We will receive official game designations on Saturday afternoon. Until then, hang tight.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zach-charb.headline: Zach Charbonnet (knee) was a full participant during Thursday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zach-charb.analysis: It’s obviously a positive development for Charbonnet, who appears to be on track for his season debut against the Bears in Week 8. Fantasy managers just have to keep in mind that the rug was pulled from underneath last week when the Seahawks ruled the tailback out late in the week. Jadarian Price (chest) was a limited participant, but fantasy managers who want to use a Seattle tailback on Monday night won’t have clarity until Saturday at the earliest.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zach-charb.headline: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald declined to say whether or not Zach Charbonnet (knee) would play in Week 8 against the Bears.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zach-charb.analysis: Macdonald said the team will continue to stick to their plan regarding Charbonnet’s return. The 25-year-old running back was activated from the PUP list last week, only to be ruled out before the weekend as the Seahawks were preparing to face the Chiefs. It’s worth noting that Charbonnet was a full participant in practice last week, so we would assume he will log another full week of practices this week. Should the Seahawks opt to sideline Charbonnet next week, Emanuel Wilson would again assume the role as lead back.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.headline: Bam Knight rushed five times for 19 yards in the Cardinals’ Week 10 loss to the Rams.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.analysis: Knight missed the Cardinals’ Week 9 game due to a concussion, but he had been working as the team’s primary rusher before that. Today, Tyler Allgeier handled that role, but his poor play resulted in more carries for Knight as the game progressed. Early in the fourth quarter, Knight snuck past his coverage defender on a route out of the backfield, running down the left sideline. Carson Beck slightly overthrew him, but Knight should have attempted to dive for what could have been roughly a 25-yard catch. It’s possible he lost the pass in the stadium lights. He earned two targets on the day, catching neither. Knight is a touchdown-dependent FLEX against the Chiefs in Week 11.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.headline: Bam Knight will play in Week 10 against the Rams after clearing concussion protocol.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.analysis: After being upgraded to a full participant on Thursday, Knight is officially off of the injury report and good to go for Sunday’s game against the Rams. Both Knight and Tyler Allgeier are expected to factor heavily into the Cardinals’ running game this weekend, especially with Carson Beck making his first career start with a depleted receiving corps. Both Knight and Allgeier will be fringe RB3/Flex plays in a game that could prove tough for the Cardinals’ banged-up offense.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.headline: Bam Knight (concussion) practiced in full on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.analysis: Knight is on track to resume his lead rushing role this week. Unfortunately, the Cardinals face the Seahawks, potentially rendering Knight a touchdown-dependent FLEX starter against their elite defense. Hopefully, Knight remains setback-free for the rest of the week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.headline: Bam Knight (concussion) resumed practicing on Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.analysis: Knight sat out in Week 9 against the Seahawks, but he is on track to resume his lead rushing role against the Rams this week. He was seen wearing a yellow non-contact jersey today, and will likely be listed as limited. The Rams’ defense is enjoying improved health and playing well. Knight will likely handle a FLEX-worthy role, but producing a ceiling game against this defense may be unlikely.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.headline: Cardinals declared RB Bam Knight, CB Starling Thomas V, LB Eku Leota, OL Jayden Williams, OL Jon Gaines III, and OL Albert Reese IV inactive for Week 9 against the Seahawks.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.analysis: Knight’s absence due to a concussion leaves Tyler Allgeier alone atop the running back depth chart with rookie Jeremiyah Love on injured reserve. The matchup is far from ideal against the Seahawks on the road, but Allgeier appears to be in line for a legitimate workhorse role and can be started as a viable RB2. The Cardinals press forward with veteran journeyman Gardner Minshew under center following the trade of Jacoby Brissett this week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.headline: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Bam Knight (concussion) will not play in Week 9 against the Seahawks.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.analysis: LaFleur also ruled out OL Jon Gaines II (ankle) and OT Jayden Williams (knee). Knight has been a DNP all week after suffering a concussion in Week 8’s win over the Cowboys and will officially be sidelined for Week 9. His absence, along with Jeremiyah Love’s (ankle) could create a bell cow role for Tyler Allgeier, who totaled 191 yards from scrimmage and two touchdowns in last week’s win, while fourth-year vet Evan Hull could also work into the mix. Allgeier’s volume alone will put him in the RB2 conversation this week despite the tough matchup.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.headline: Bam Knight (concussion) was not spotted at Thursday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.analysis: It appears it’ll be another DNP for Knight as he entered the concussion protocol following Sunday’s win over the Cowboys in Week 8. The 25-year-old tailback seems unlikely to be able to go in Week 9 against the Seahawks, but there should be further updates on Knight’s status soon.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.headline: Bam Knight (concussion) did not practice Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.analysis: Knight entered concussion protocol after a hit to the head in Week 8 against the Cowboys. Starting out as a DNP this week means he still has a few steps to go to clear protocol by Sunday. Unless he can progress through protocol quickly, Knight is on the wrong side of questionable for Week 9 against the Seahawks.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.headline: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Bam Knight is in the league’s concussion protocol.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.analysis: Knight will need to clear protocol if he hopes to suit up in time to play in Week 9 against the Seahawks. The former UDFA has turned in a solid season thus far for the Cardinals, rushing for 28-168-0 while adding another six receptions for 43 additional yards. With Jeremiyah Love (ankle) likely to miss time, Knight could again find himself in a split with Tyler Allgeier when he returns. The Cardinals will likely need to address their running back room at some point in the week with Allgeier currently being the only healthy back on the roster.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.headline: FOX’s Pam Oliver reports Zonovan Knight (head) left Arizona’s Week 8 game against the Cowboys and won’t return.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/zonovan-kn.analysis: She got word from Mike LaFleur that Knight would be out. Knight wasn’t officially given an injury declaration as of yet, but it was a fairly textbook shoulder-to-the-head that caused a fumble towards the waning moments of the second half. Knight had 18 total yards on three carries and one catch before leaving. We would be surprised, given how brutal the hit he took looked, if he were available for Week 9. This leaves Tyler Allgeier as the lone healthy back for the second half of this game.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.headline: Simi Fehoko caught 1-of-2 targets for 21 yards in the Cardinals’ Week 10 loss to the Rams.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.analysis: Fehoko caught his lone catchable pass for a 21-yard play-action gain on the opening drive. His second target was off-target and resulted in an incompletion. Fehoko does not need to be rostered for the Cardinals’ Week 11 game against the Chiefs.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.headline: Cardinals re-signed WR Simi Fehoko to a one-year contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.analysis: Fehoko had a tough go in 2025. In the Cardinals’ Week 10 game against the Seahawks, Fehoko badly sprained an ankle on a special teams play. He returned to the game after having it taped up and then broke his arm making a tackle on the following kickoff. Fehoko, 28, also failed to earn a target last season. He will likely function as a run blocker and special teams player and should not be drafted this season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.headline: Cardinals signed RB Michael Carter to their practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.analysis: Carter surprisingly lost out to Zonovan Knight for the final roster spot at running back, but decided to remain with the Cardinals practice squad. Joining him so far are: WR Andre Baccellia, LB Elliott Brown, OL Jeremiah Byers, OL Jake Curhan, TE Josiah Deguara, WR Simi Fehoko, DL Anthony Goodlow, CB Darren Hall, OL Sincere Haynesworth, OL Nick Leverett, WR Tejhaun Palmer and DL Elijah Simmons.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.headline: Cardinals waived WR Simi Fehoko.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.analysis: He announced the news via TikTok by saying the “grim reaper done got me.” Fehoko played 41 preseason snaps and finished with a 71.6 PFF offensive grade. The 28-year-old has a shot to catch on elsewhere as an end-of-roster or practice squad possession receiver. He has 310 career NFL snaps over the last four seasons.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.headline: Cardinals signed WR Simi Fehoko, formerly of the Chargers, to a one-year contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.analysis: Typically a special teamer, Fehoko set season highs across the board on offense last year with six catches for 106 yards. An elbow injury cost him the second half of the season. Fehoko is a depth option at receiver but brings more to the table through his special teams production. He will need to maintain a special teams role in Arizona to secure a roster spot.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.headline: Chargers activated WR Simi Fehoko (elbow) from injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.analysis: LA also brought Eli Apple off IR. Both players will fill depth roles for the Chargers’ in their Wild Card Round matchup with Houston. With Josh Palmer ruled out, Fehoko could be in the mix for WR3 duties along with DJ Chark.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.headline: Simi Fehoko (elbow) practiced in full on Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.analysis: Fehoko has a chance to return from injured reserve this week. No. 2 WR Quentin Johnston (thigh/illness) and Joshua Palmer (heel) were both sidelined on Wednesday so Fehoko’s improvement comes at the right time. He could suit up as the Chargers’ No. 3 WR this week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.headline: Chargers placed WR Simi Fehoko on injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.analysis: The team signed Jalen Reagor to their active roster in a corresponding move. Reagor and DJ Chark will serve as depth options in the Chargers’ receiving rotation. Chark was activated from injured reserve last week but did not suit up on Sunday.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.headline: Simi Fehoko caught his only target for a nine-yard touchdown in the Chargers’ Week 8 win over the Bears.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.analysis: Fehoko saw a fleeting window of additional snaps as Joshua Palmer left the game for one possession after aggravating his knee injury, a drive that culminated in a nine-yard touchdown grab on a crossing route over the middle of the field. He won’t be a fantasy option even if Palmer misses time.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.headline: Cowboys designated WR Simi Fehoko to return from injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/simi-fehok.analysis: The same is true of rookie LB Devin Harper. Supposedly a training camp standout, Fehoko had caught four balls in five games before going down. If the Cowboys make a return and Fehoko returns, he will either be a game-day inactive or called upon on special teams.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devin-duve.headline: Devin Duvernay caught 2-of3 targets for 35 yards in the Cardinals’ Week 10 loss to the Rams.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devin-duve.analysis: Duvernay briefly got going on the Cardinals’ second drive, taking a screen pass for four yards before producing a 31-yard catch on a corner route. Unfortunately, on the Cardinals’ fifth drive, he twirled to the ground while trying to catch a pass and ended up flipping the football right into Rams S Kam Kinchens’ hands for an interception. Duvernay should not be trusted to return FLEX value against the Chiefs next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devin-duve.headline: Cardinals signed WR/KR Devin Duvernay, formerly of the Bears, to a one-year, $2.5 million contract.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devin-duve.analysis: NFL insider Jordan Schultz was the first to report the deal. Duvernay is set to join his fourth team in four seasons. The former third-round has been used almost exclusively as a return specialist after seeing some work on offense during his tenure with the Ravens. Duvernay was a two-time Pro Bowler and was also named a First-team All-Pro in 2021 for his skills as a return man, and totaled 1,069 kick return yards while averaging 26.7 yards per return last season in Chicago. It’s unlikely he sees an expanded role next season in Arizona.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devin-duve.headline: Bears signed WR Devin Duvernay.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devin-duve.analysis: Duvernay provides wide receiver depth and will likely compete for a special teams role as a returner. He is not fantasy-relevant. The Bears also signed LS Scott Daly, placed DL Austin Booker on injured reserve with a designation to return, waived LB Carl Jones Jr., signed TE Nikola Kalinic, DB Dontae Manning and S Gervarrius Owens to the practice squad while releasing LS Luke Elkin and DB Mekhi Garner.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devin-duve.headline: Jaguars released WR Devin Duvernay.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devin-duve.analysis: The release of Duvernay, who signed a two-year, $8.5 million contract, will clear just over $2.7 million in cap space for the Jaguars. Duvernay returned 19 punts for 167 yards and 14 kicks for 351 yards last season. Duvernay has never totaled more than 37 receptions in his five professional seasons, and won’t be viewed as anything more than a special teamer on the open market. The 2021 First-Team All-Pro returner will be 27 at the start of next season and should draw plenty of interest from special teams coaches.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devin-duve.headline: Ravens selected Texas WR Devin Duvernay with the No. 92 overall pick in the 2020 NFL Draft.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devin-duve.analysis: Duvernay (5’10/200) totaled 70/1,082/7 receiving through his first three years with the Longhorns before being moved exclusively into the slot (97.4% rate) and walking away with his most productive season (106/1,386/9) of his college career. A former state-champion sprinter, Duvernay wins with 4.39 speed and short-area burst (1.51-second three-cone) near the line of scrimmage. He also finished with the second-most first downs (68) and only three drops among FBS receivers in 2019, partially because the program simplified his touches with 42 screen plays. Duvernay will need to improve his releases against man coverage before stepping foot on the boundary in the NFL, but his 93rd-percentile Adjusted SPARQ athleticism should at the very least make him a candidate for manufactured touches from the slot at the next level.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devin-duve.headline: 247 Sports college football analyst Barton Simmons thinks Texas WR Devin Duvernay is undervalued based on his current draft projections.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devin-duve.analysis: Duvernay (5'10/200) is currently being projected as an end of Day 2-early Day 3 selection. His straight line speed is elite, as is evidenced by his 4.39 40-yard dash time and track pedigree. However his lack of prototype size and raw route-running ability are depressing his value in draftnik circles. Simmons praises Duvernay, saying “he’s got great touchness and run-after-catch ability and he doesn’t drop passes.” Duvernay was incredibly productive at UT last season, earning a PFF receiving grade of 89.6 and a superb 91.0 Hands grade over the last two seasons. To put into perspective how sure-handed Duvernay is, he amazingly only dropped three passes on 194 targets since 2018.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devin-duve.headline: Texas WR Devin Duvernay ran the 40-yard dash in 4.39 seconds at the NFL Scouting Combine.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devin-duve.analysis: Duvernay (5'10/200) matched Memphis’ Antonio Gibson for the fastest 40-yard dash time in the first group of receivers running on Thursday. No stunner on this fast time, as the sure-handed wide receiver was a track star in high school. He remains somewhat raw as a route-runner, but plays with strength and (obviously) real speed. Duvernay -- who is Kyler Murray’s cousin -- could potentially push for a Day 2 selection in the draft, but probably more comfortably fits as an early Day 3 pick.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devin-duve.headline: NFL Media’s Lance Zierlein wrote that Texas WR Devin Duvernay has “very reliable, soft hands.”
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devin-duve.analysis: Duvernay (5'10/200) was highly productive last season, catching 106 passes for 1,386 yards and nine touchdowns. Projected to go at some point during the middle rounds of April’s draft, the former Longhorn wideout has some work to do as a route-runner but the consistency as a pass-catcher is evident. “He’s a slot receiver with tight hips and below-average routes but has outstanding hands and uses power to add yards after catch,” Zierlein wrote in his analysis of Duvernay.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devin-duve.headline: Texas senior WR Devin Duvernay caught three passes for 92 yards and a touchdown in a 38-10 victory over Utah in the Valero Alamo Bowl Tuesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devin-duve.analysis: Duvernay (5'11"/210) led the Longhorns in receiving and caught a an acrobatic contested fade-pass in the back-corner of the end-zone to put Texas up 31-10. Duvernay had an incredible senior season, snagging 106 passes for 1,386 yards and nine touchdowns in 13 games for UT. Duvernay is yet another member of this year’s loaded wide receiver class and should make waves during the evaluation process as a speedster who posted a 10.2 100-meter time in high school. He should be selected in the middle rounds of the 2020 NFL Draft.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devin-duve.headline: Texas senior WR Devin Duvernay (shoulder) is expected to play and figure prominently in the Longhorns’ game plan for Tuesday’s Alamo Bowl matchup with Utah.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/devin-duve.analysis: Duvernay (5'11/210) was outstanding in the Longhorns’ win over Texas Tech to finish the regular season, catching six passes for 199 yards and a touchdown. And he could have done even more, if not for a shoulder injury that knocked him out of the game. The time off has benefitted both Duvernay and fellow senior Collin Johnson, who has struggled with a hamstring injury for most of the season. Both are healthy and will be key targets for QB Sam Ehlinger in Tuesday’s season finale. It’s also worth noting that Duvernay, who has received Day 2 draft projections, has been invited to participate in the NFL Scouting Combine.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tre-tucker.headline: Tre Tucker caught 1-of-2 targets for nine yards in the Raiders’ Week 10 loss against the Seahawks.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tre-tucker.analysis: The Raiders had a meager 146 passing yards in Fernando Mendoza’s first NFL start. Tucker, the leading Vegas wideout headed into Week 10, wasn’t targeted until the fourth quarter against the elite Seahawks secondary. The loss of Kirk Cousins in a trade to the Vikings last week might be the end of Tucker’s fleeting fantasy relevance unless Mendoza improves in the coming weeks. If Brock Bowers (ankle) misses time, Tucker could see a slight uptick in targets.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tre-tucker.headline: Tre Tucker caught 4-of-8 targets for 55 yards in the Raiders’ Week 9 loss to the 49ers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tre-tucker.analysis: Tucker occupied his usual role as the team’s de facto No. 1 wideout, almost connecting with Kirk Cousins in the second half for what likely would have been a long touchdown. Tucker was tied for the team lead in targets with Brock Bowers. His air yards domination gives Tucker a fairly high weekly ceiling in a Vegas offense usually chasing points in the second half. Tucker will be an iffy option next week against Seattle.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tre-tucker.headline: Tre Tucker was held without a catch in the Raiders’ Week 8 win over the Jets.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tre-tucker.analysis: Coming off 10/200/3 over the past two weeks, Tucker somehow commanded only one target in a game where the Raiders scored 38 points. It was the first time since the opener he caught fewer than four passes. Tucker has definitely benefitted from some garbage time production, but he is not typically going to be a zero waiting to happen. He can still be trotted out there as a low-end WR3 for a Week 9 matchup where the Raiders are going to have to pass to compete with the 49ers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tre-tucker.headline: Tre Tucker caught 5-of-12 targets for 103 yards and a touchdown in the Raiders’ Week 7 loss to the Rams.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tre-tucker.analysis: It was a quiet day for Tucker until the Raiders once again found themselves down by three scores in the fourth quarter. Kirk Cousins — as he did last week against Buffalo — let it rip and peppered Tucker with late downfield targets, one of them resulting in an impressive 37-yard touchdown. Tucker led all Vegas pass catchers with a dozen targets and dominated air yards as usual. Last week against the Bills, Tucker went for 97 yards and two scores on five receptions. The miserable Raiders defense should lead to plenty of runaway negative game script for the team’s offense in the coming weeks, and Tucker’s role as the team’s lone deep ball option gives him weekly upside. He’ll be a WR3 option in Week 8 against the Jets.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tre-tucker.headline: Tre Tucker caught 5-of-7 targets for 97 yards and two touchdowns in the Raiders’ Week 6 loss to the Bills.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tre-tucker.analysis: Tucker found the end zone on an 11-yard touchdown pass from Kirk Cousins in the fourth quarter to tie the game at 23-23. Later in the game, with the Raiders down by 10, Tucker found himself on the receiving end of a Kirk Cousins moon ball in the end zone, which he hauled in for a 44-yard touchdown to cut the Bills’ lead to 33-30 with just over a minute left in the game. Tucker is the closest thing the Raiders have to a fantasy-viable wide receiver, and he has proven to be a volatile player throughout his four-year career. Fantasy managers shouldn’t view him as anything more than a boom-or-bust WR4 in next week’s game against the Rams.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tre-tucker.headline: Tre Tucker caught 4-of-5 targets for 41 yards in the Raiders’ Week 5 loss to the Patriots, adding two rushes for -7 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tre-tucker.analysis: Tucker’s two rushing attempts were blown up in the backfield. He was third on the team in targets, trailing Brock Bowers and Ashton Jeanty. Tucker, who usually operates as the team’s primary downfield option, should have some appeal in Week 6 against Buffalo in what could be a high-scoring game. He has at least four receptions in four of five games this season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tre-tucker.headline: Tre Tucker caught 4-of-8 targets for 44 yards in the Raiders’ Week 4 loss to the Chiefs.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tre-tucker.analysis: Tucker’s longest catch came on a 23-yard reception late in the fourth quarter as the Raiders looked to drive and tie up the game. Had the replay officials called for a review of the play in time, the catch likely would have been overturned, but the play was upheld, much to the disappointment of the Chiefs and head coach Andy Reid. The eight targets Tucker saw in this one set a new season high. He’s totaled 44 or fewer yards in three of four games this season and will be hard to trust as anything more than a dart-throw WR4 in Week 5 against the Patriots.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tre-tucker.headline: Tre Tucker caught 4-of-4 targets for 43 yards in the Raiders’ Week 3 win over the Saints.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tre-tucker.analysis: Tucker had a bigger impact in real life than he did in fantasy. On the plus side, he helped set up a field goal and a touchdown, first by finding the soft spot in the Saints’ zone coverage in the two-minute drill. Later, his 15-yard gain on a deep crossing route helped set up the Raiders. He also committed a holding penalty, which erased a short gain for RB Ashton Jeanty. Tucker is a WR4/FLEX against the Chiefs next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tre-tucker.headline: Tre Tucker caught 5-of-7 targets for 119 yards and a touchdown in the Raiders’ Week 2 win over the Chargers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tre-tucker.analysis: Kirk Cousins got the deep ball going in this game after settling for mostly check-downs in Week 1. Tucker caught two passes of 40+ yards, the first of which was a second-quarter touchdown. He also tied Ashton Jeanty with a team-high seven targets, so it wasn’t just a one-off deep shot for the veteran wideout. Brock Bowers is expected to return next week, meaning Tucker’s target share should take a hit the next time we see him. Even if he is relegated to field-stretching duties in Week 3, Tucker will remain a high-ceiling FLEX bet versus the Saints.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tre-tucker.headline: Tre Tucker caught 2-of-4 targets for 27 yards in the Raiders’ Week 1 win over the Dolphins.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/tre-tucker.analysis: Despite receiving clear-cut No. 1 wide receiver treatment late in the preseason, Tucker was not the clear-cut No. 1 wide receiver in Week 1. He nabbed a nice 21-yard gain and had another downfield pass broken up by DPI, but Raiders coach Klint Kubiak didn’t have a focal target here. Treat Tucker as a boom-bust FLEX against the Chargers next week, in what should be a back-and-forth game environment.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aj-barner/.headline: AJ Barner caught all three of his targets for 19 yards in the Seahawks’ Week 10 win against the Raiders.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aj-barner/.analysis: Running a pass routes on 18 of the team’s 23 drop backs, Barner again had nice involvement in the Seattle offense but not much in the way of usage. Barner now has more than two receptions in just four games on the season. That puts him out of streaming contention in most fantasy leagues.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aj-barner/.headline: AJ Barner caught 2-of-4 targets for seven yards and a touchdown in the Seahawks’ Week 9 win over the Cardinals, adding three yards and a touchdown on three carries.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aj-barner/.analysis: Barner kicked off the scoring in the second quarter with a tight end sneak from one yard out, adding a second score on the following possession on a beautiful, fingertip grab in the flat from seven yards out. Quarterback Drew Lock delivered the football late and behind the veteran tight end, the latter of whom adjusted in the face of suffocating pressure to pluck the football from the air and hold on through the ground for the touchdown. Barner remains highly unlikely to see consistent weekly volume in this Seattle offense, but fantasy managers can benefit from high variance touchdowns every so often.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aj-barner/.headline: AJ Barner caught 2-of-5 targets for 23 yards in the Seahawks’ Week 8 loss to the Bears.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aj-barner/.analysis: Barner is far from fantasy consideration having only one game through eight appearances with more than a modest five targets while failing to notch a single receiving touchdown. Fantasy managers can safely return him to the waiver wire in all formats.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aj-barner/.headline: AJ Barner caught 4-of-5 targets for 42 yards in the Seahawks’ Week 7 win over the Chiefs, adding four yards on three carries.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aj-barner/.analysis: All three carries for Barner were tush push plays that resulted in first downs in key situations, while his five targets tied his second most of the young season. Even so, that was not enough to return a usable fantasy week outside of tight end premium leagues, keeping Barner best left on the bench or returned to the waiver wire, regardless of the severity of Rashid Shaheed’s injury.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aj-barner/.headline: AJ Barner caught 3-of-5 targets for 20 yards in the Seahawks’ Week 5 loss to the 49ers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aj-barner/.analysis: Barner continues to be a non-factor in the Seahawks’ passing game. Outside of a Week 3 game against the Commanders in which he went for 5-69-0 on nine targets, Barner has totaled 53 yards in his other four games combined and has yet to find the end zone this season. Barner won’t be on the streaming radar in Week 6, even with four teams on bye.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aj-barner/.headline: AJ Barner caught 1-of-3 targets for 12 yards in the Seahawks’ Week 4 win over the Chargers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aj-barner/.analysis: After a solid effort against the the Commanders where he caught five passes for 69 yards, Barner was once again a non-factor in this one. The 24-year-old is clearly the top tight end in the passing attack, but outside of Jaxon Smith-Njigba, the rest of the options just haven’t done much. He’ll be a boom or bust TE1 for Week 5 against the 49ers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aj-barner/.headline: AJ Barner caught 5-of-9 targets for 69 yards in the Seahawks’ Week 3 loss to the Commanders.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aj-barner/.analysis: It was easily Barner’s best receiving day of the year, although he was unable to find the end zone. His nine targets were second on the team behind Jaxon Smith-Njigba’s 14, and it’s clear he and Sam Darnold have more of a connection than he did with Drew Lock. Barner will be on the TE1 precipice for Week 4 against the Chargers, but this was encouraging.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aj-barner/.headline: AJ Barner caught 1-of-1 targets for eight yards in the Seahawks’ Week 2 win over the Cardinals, adding one rush for one yard and one touchdown.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aj-barner/.analysis: Up 24-7 on 4th-and-goal with just over three minutes left in the game, the Seahawks started a fresh set of downs from the Cardinals’ three-yard line. Both RB George Holani and RB Emanuel Wilson were given chances to punch it in before Seahawks OC Brian Fleury dialed up a Tush Push play for Barner on 4th-and-goal. Barner jumped up and across the line, bringing his fantasy stat line from something unusable to something we can live with. He remains a boom-bust TE1 against the Commanders next week. Seahawks TE2 Elijah Arroyo nabbed a 17-yard pass on a post route, but that was it for him. So far, the Seahawks’ reported uptick in usage for the tight end position has not panned out.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aj-barner/.headline: A.J. Barner caught both of his targets for 13 yards in the Seahawks’ Week 1 win over the Patriots.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aj-barner/.analysis: Barner also had a tush push attempt that was called back by a penalty. With Jaxon Smith-Njigba soaking up 11 targets on just 24 team pass attempts, there wasn’t much volume to go around for the rest of the Seattle pass-catchers. Barner only topped four catches in 20 combined regular and postseason appearances last year. If Week 1 is any indication, he won’t be putting up big box scores very often this season either. He will barely crack the TE2 ranks when Seattle takes on Arizona next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aj-barner/.headline: Seahawks TE AJ Barner (oblique) is practicing in full for Week 1 against the Patriots.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/aj-barner/.analysis: The Seahawks’ starting tight end is firmly on track to play in the 2026 season opener on Wednesday night. Barner is reportedly set to handle a bigger role than he did last year, when he finished as the PPR TE14. He can only be viewed as a borderline TE1/2 early on, though.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.headline: Trey McBride caught 5-of-5 targets for 37 yards in the Cardinals’ Week 10 loss to the Rams.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.analysis: Initially, it looked like McBride might not experience much of a drop-off with Carson Beck at the helm, catching 2-of-2 targets for 13 yards on the opening drive. The Cardinals’ offense then began to falter, and the Rams jumped out to a 17-6 lead by the end of the first half. From there, the Rams’ defense focused on flustering Beck, and the Cardinals’ rushing attack was unable to make them pay. McBride led the team in targets and will still be a TE1 next week against the Chiefs. As he and Beck hone their connection, his box score results may fluctuate more than we’d like in the coming weeks, though.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.headline: Carson Beck will start for the Cardinals in Week 10 against the Rams.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.analysis: With Jacoby Brissett in Baltimore and Gardner Minshew out because of a UCL injury, the Cardinals are already down to their third-string quarterback. It was almost a given that Beck would start at some point this year, though we imagine head coach Matt LaFleur didn’t think it would be this soon. Beck played well in his lone preseason appearance, throwing for 188 yards and a score. While he’s not much of a streaming option this week, he should be good enough to keep Trey McBride at the top of the TE1 ranks, especially with Michael Wilson done for the year.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.headline: Trey McBride caught 7-of-8 targets for 54 yards in the Cardinals’ Week 9 loss to the Seahawks.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.analysis: The lone incompletion directed toward McBride came on the team’s final play of the game when the veteran tight end was unable to corral an end zone target that was thrown slightly behind him on fourth and goal. McBride combined with alpha wide receiver Michael Wilson to account for 15 targets on 30 Minshew pass attempts, something we’d expect to continue forward give the current state of the team. The Cardinals get another difficult matchup against the Rams in Week 10, where McBride will remain a surefire TE1 in fantasy circles.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.headline: ESPN’s Adam Schefter reports the Broncos checked on Trey McBride.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.analysis: To no one’s surprise, the Cardinals hung up the phone in record time. Even as a perennially rebuilding franchise, Arizona was never going to trade arguably the league’s best tight end in the middle of his prime. Schefter added that the Cardinals have “checked in around the league on tight ends.” Evan Engram has a measly 13 catches for 136 yards this year and Denver’s passing attack has taken a step back despite acquiring Jaylen Waddle in the offseason. Dallas Goedert is the biggest name believed to be available at tight end ahead of Tuesday’s deadline. On an expiring contract, he wouldn’t cost the Broncos much. Carolina tight end Ja’Tavion Sanders is likely on the trade block as well.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.headline: Trey McBride caught 7-of-8 targets for 72 yards and a touchdown in Arizona’s Week 8 win over the Cowboys.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.analysis: McBride’s touchdown with 2:11 left seemed like it would be a bit of a fantasy afterthought, but it quickly proved important as the Cowboys fizzled out after a failed onside kick by Arizona. The veteran tight end caught four passes and 44 yards of this production, as well as the touchdown, once Jacoby Brissett left the game. He’ll remain a don’t-have-to-think-about-it TE1 even in a tough matchup against Seattle in Week 9.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.headline: Trey McBride caught 10-of-13 targets for 111 yards and a touchdown in the Cardinals’ Week 7 loss to the Broncos.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.analysis: The Cardinals couldn’t get much going on offense, but that’s not a problem for McBride. He accounted for 27 percent of the team’s targets and was the only Cardinal to find the end zone on the day. McBride did so on a seven-yard strike from Brissett in the third quarter. Despite posting weekly TE1 numbers, this is McBride’s first 100-yard outing of the season. Facing a laughable Dallas defense next week, McBride will likely clock in as the TE1 overall in the weekly rankings.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.headline: Trey McBride caught 7-of-9 targets for 53 yards in the Cardinals’ Week 6 win over the Rams.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.analysis: McBride’s first target ended up being a Quentin Lake interception, but Jacoby Brissett went right back to his star tight end on the following drive. McBride made a contested catch on a quick in route, spun off contact and took off downfield for a 26-yard gain. McBride’s day largely consisted of out routes and catches in the flats after that, but he was given two opportunities to score a touchdown from inside the Rams’ 25-yard line on the Cardinals’ seventh drive. On 2nd-and-1 from the Rams’ 21-yard line, McBride caught a pass in the flats and rumbled through contact for a short first-down gain. Three plays later, on 3rd-and-goal from the Rams’ seven-yard line, Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur dialed up a screen pass for him, but the Rams blew it up, resulting in a yardage loss. It wasn’t McBride biggest outing, but a 7/53 is hardly unusable. McBride remains an elite TE1 against the Broncos next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.headline: ArizonaCardinals.com’s Darren Urban believes Carson Beck won’t start in the “immediate future.”
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.analysis: Cardinals fans appear to be pining for the team to bench Jacoby Brissett and start the rookie in the coming weeks as another season circles the drain for Arizona. Beck so far has been the Cards’ emergency third quarterback. Urban said there remains a “chance Beck is made the backup this week or next and allow him to come on in relief if the situation presents itself. I don’t see Beck starting in the immediate future, but it does feel his time grows closer, and if the offense continues to sputter, that would be understandable.” Brissett this season ranks 15th in passing yards. He’s thrown nine touchdowns to five interceptions and ranks 30th out of 37 qualifying QBs in adjusted yards per attempt. He won’t be a viable fantasy play this week against a tough Rams coverage unit.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.headline: Trey McBride caught 9-of-10 targets for 66 yards and one touchdown in the Cardinals’ Week 5 loss to the Lions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.analysis: McBride looked like his normal, dominant self, carving up defenders on out routes and in-breakers. Unfortunately, hearts were also broken when Jacoby Brissett fired a touchdown pass right past McBride, running wide open inside the Lions’ five-yard line, to backup TE Teagan Quitoriano, also running wide open in the back of the end zone. Fortunately, McBride was able to haul in a juggling, falling and contested touchdown catch late in the fourth quarter to boost his final stat line. McBride is an elite TE1 against the Rams next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.headline: Trey McBride caught 7-of-12 targets for 31 yards in the Cardinals’ Week 4 loss to the Giants.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/trey-mcbri.analysis: It was another compiling-based statistical performance for the Cardinals’ dominant seam stretcher, but the PPR check clears all the same. Amazingly, seven catches were actually a new season low. McBride is going to keep stacking volume efforts, but he has now been out-targeted 30-23 by Michael Wilson over the past two weeks, not that a single soul is concerned about 23 targets in two games. Potentially more concerning is the negative chatter arising around Jacoby Brissett’s play. Either way, McBride has a Week 5 smash spot in the Lions.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jadarian-p.headline: Jadarian Price had nine rushes for 36 yards and a touchdown in the Seahawks’ Week 10 win against the Raiders, adding one catch for eight yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jadarian-p.analysis: It was Price’s first touchdown of the season, and it came on a 12-yard rush around the left edge against a Vegas run defense that has collapsed in recent weeks. Zach Charbonnet, meanwhile, led the backfield with 20 carries for 94 scoreless yards. Charbonnet ran 15 routes to seven routes for Price. When the Seahawks return from bye in Week 12, Price will be a deep league flex option in the run-first Seattle offense.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jadarian-p.headline: Jadarian Price rushed nine times for 24 yards in the Seahawks’ Week 9 win over the Cardinals, adding 54 yards on four receptions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jadarian-p.analysis: Price’s 13 opportunities lagged the 18 of Zach Charbonnet in what is developing into a true 60-40 split between him and the veteran, and while the 54 yards through the air were impressive, Price appears to need consistent aerial production to sustain his fantasy value moving forward while playing on the wrong side of a timeshare. Hopefully he can improve upon the modest 2.7 yards per carry he notched against the Cardinals when the Seahawks take on the sliding Raiders in Week 10.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jadarian-p.headline: Jadarian Price rushed 10 times for 29 yards in the Seahawks’ Week 8 loss to the Bears, adding eight yards on two receptions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jadarian-p.analysis: It was Zach Charbonnet that drew the start for the Seahawks in his first game since tearing his ACL last year, but it was the talented rookie that led the team in opportunities. Price was making his first appearance since going on the injured reserve with a chest injury suffered in Week 2, and while he led the team in yardage and carries, George Holani remained involved in clear passing situations and Charbonnet is liable to see his role continue to grow with each healthy game. Price will be a shaky FLEX option in a better matchup against the Cardinals in Week 9.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jadarian-p.headline: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports the Seahawks plan to activate Jadarian Price from injured reserve and that he will play in Week 8 against the Bears.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jadarian-p.analysis: Price and Zach Charbonnet will both make their returns from injured reserve tonight, putting the Seahawks’ backfield at full strength heading into a pivotal NFC matchup. It’s hard to know how the touches will be spread out in this one, which makes both backs hard to trust on Monday night against the Bears. Price averaged 11.5 carries per game in his two full games played this season, but Charbonnet should eat into that somewhat. Fantasy managers looking to play either Seattle running back in this one should temper expectations until we have more data to go on in the coming weeks.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jadarian-p.headline: Seahawks removed Jadarian Price (chest) from the injury report Saturday and he is expected to play in Week 8 against the Bears.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jadarian-p.analysis: The team has yet to activate him from injured reserve, a procedural move that is expected to come before they take the field in Week 8 against the Bears on Monday Night Football. Zach Charbonnet is also expected to be activated from injured reserve, giving the team their top two backs for the first time this season. No word yet on an expected snap count for either, although Price would seem to be in line to serve as the top option in the backfield considering it will be Charbonnet’s season debut.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jadarian-p.headline: Jadarian Price (chest) was upgraded to “full” for Friday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jadarian-p.analysis: Price was upgraded to full while Zach Charbonnet (knee) was downgraded to limited. That is probably part of a pre-planned process with Charbonnet, but as of Friday evening, we suppose Price is now technically closer to returning than his veteran backfield mate. As it is, both players now seem more likely than not to suit up, which would make for an extremely chaotic fantasy situation with Emanuel Wilson still in the fold. With the Seahawks playing on Monday evening, we will receive official game designations Saturday afternoon.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jadarian-p.headline: Jadarian Price (chest) was a limited participant during Thursday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jadarian-p.analysis: Price gets in the limited session after coach Mike Macdonald said that it was realistic that the tailback could be back Monday night against the Bears in Week 8. Zach Charbonnet was a full participant Thursday, so the Seattle backfield could finally be at full strength — or close to it, anyway — for the stretch. That’s nice for the Seahawks, but creates a lot of confusion from a fantasy perspective.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jadarian-p.headline: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said it’s “realistic” that Jadarian Price (chest/IR) could return in Week 8.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jadarian-p.analysis: With Zach Charbonnet’s status also in some doubt, Seattle’s backfield situation likely won’t be sorted out until Saturday (or MNF inactives), but if Price is back that’s probably the end of Emmanuel Wilson’s short-term RB2 ride. We’ll keep an eye on the situation. Wilson-reliant managers might want to consider alternative arrangements for Week 8.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jadarian-p.headline: Seahawks coach Mike MacDonald said the team would designate Jadarian Price (chest) to return from injured reserve this week.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jadarian-p.analysis: Price has missed the minimum four games and being immediately designated to return should have him making his debut sooner rather than later. Of course, with Zach Charbonnet also returning to the fold soon, this could be a split backfield rather than the RB2 zone that Price looked to be opening the year in. Price probably will only reach the FLEX ranks when active until we see what the touch counts look like; perhaps he could have a Blake Corum-ish role if all goes well for the Seahawks offense.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jadarian-p.headline: Seahawks placed RB Jadarian Price (chest) on injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jadarian-p.analysis: Price reportedly aggravated a chest injury during the team’s Wednesday practice and will now miss the next four games, at minimum, as he tends to the injury. The backfield will be left in the hands of Emanuel Wilson and George Holani in Week 4 against the Chargers but should get reinforcements in short order with Zach Charbonnet set to resume practicing. Price’s season continues to trend poorly for fantasy managers that invested a mid-round pick in his services this summer.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/cooper-kup.headline: Cooper Kupp caught his only target for a 34-yard touchdown in the Seahawks’ Week 10 win against the Raiders.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/cooper-kup.analysis: Kupp was the recipient of a highlight reel throw from Drew Lock, who had two touchdown tosses on the day. It was Kupp’s third touchdown on the season. With only three games this season with more than three catches, Kupp should not be rostered in most fantasy formats ahead of Seattle’s Week 11 bye.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/cooper-kup.headline: Cooper Kupp caught 3-of-4 targets for 32 yards in the Seahawks’ Week 9 win over the Cardinals.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/cooper-kup.analysis: Backup quarterback Drew Lock attempted only 28 passes on a night their defense held the Cardinals to under 200 yards of total offense, leaving little more than scraps for Kupp, despite the absence of Rashid Shaheed. Further uncertainty persists given the multi-game injury to starting quarterback Sam Darnold and the oblique injury sustained by Lock, with the offense potentially helmed by Jalen Milroe when they face the Raiders in Week 10. Kupp remains far from the fantasy radar.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/cooper-kup.headline: Cooper Kupp caught 1-of-3 targets for seven yards and a touchdown in the Seahawks’ Week 8 loss to the Bears.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/cooper-kup.analysis: Kupp was unable to take advantage of the absence of fellow receiver Rashid Shaheed but did cash in for his second touchdown of the season. Kupp’s days of consistent fantasy production are long behind him as the Seahawks head into a Week 9 divisional meeting against the Cardinals approaching must-win territory.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/cooper-kup.headline: Cooper Kupp caught both targets for 20 yards in the Seahawks’ Week 7 win over the Chiefs.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/cooper-kup.analysis: Kupp saw sparse usage as Jaxon Smith-Njigba went off in the first half and the team transitioned to a run-heavy approach while playing with a lead after the break. Fellow receiver Rashid Shaheed departed with a knee injury following a collision with Smith-Njigba in the end zone at the end of the second quarter, which is something managers will will want to monitor ahead of a Week 8 meeting with the Bears on Monday Night Football. Kupp could work his way into the FLEX discussion if Shaheed misses time.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/cooper-kup.headline: Cooper Kupp caught 5-of-10 targets for 50 yards in the Seahawks’ Week 6 loss to the Broncos.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/cooper-kup.analysis: Kupp’s 10 targets finished second on the team behind alpha Jaxon Smith-Njigba but were largely a product of 51 Sam Darnold pass attempts in game that had all the ingredients for increased pass volume, including an inability to run the football, negative game script, and overtime.
