https://www.nbcsports.com/adonai-mitchel.headline: Adonai Mitchell (knee) is questionable to play in Week 10 against the Bills.
https://www.nbcsports.com/adonai-mitchel.analysis: Mitchell practiced in full today, but was added to the injury report with a new knee issue. This is a little concerning. The team could be trying to collect more info right now. We expect to hear more later today or at some point tomorrow. At this point, Mitchell must be viewed as firmly in the questionable column.

https://www.nbcsports.com/adonai-mitchel.headline: Adonai Mitchell didn’t catch any of his seven targets in the Jets’ Week 9 loss to the Chiefs.
https://www.nbcsports.com/adonai-mitchel.analysis: A week after going ballistic against the Raiders, the high-variance Mitchell couldn’t come up with a grab in an embarrassing effort for a Jets offense that was without Garrett Wilson (concussion). If your fantasy league awards points for air yards, Mitchell would have been a week winner against Kansas City. Alas, he could not convert any of that opportunity into real-life production, though he came awfully close on a couple well-thrown Geno Smith downfield balls. He was second on the team in targets, trailing Omar Cooper (11). Mitchell next week against the Bills will remain a boom-bust WR3 option. Buffalo has struggled against boundary receivers all season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/adonai-mitchel.headline: Adonai Mitchell caught 7-of-9 targets for 142 yards and a touchdown in the Jets’ Week 8 loss to the Raiders.
https://www.nbcsports.com/adonai-mitchel.analysis: Looking to bounce back from a Week 7 doughnut in his return from a marathon injury absence, Mitchell responded with by far the best game of his career. This, even as one of his two missed connections was a heinous deep drop. Geno Smith never stopped looking his way, and the quarterback was rewarded with multiple chunk gains. Smith once again failed to get fully in sync with Garrett Wilson. Smith also targeted Omar Cooper Jr. zero times. That was hard to see coming, and will be difficult to sustain going forward, keeping Mitchell as more of a boom/bust WR3/4 than weekly must start. This blow-up effort confirmed he still has life in 12-team leagues, however. That will include for Week 9 against a Chiefs defense that is admittedly much better than Vegas’ porous unit.

https://www.nbcsports.com/adonai-mitchel.headline: Adonai Mitchell failed to catch any of his three targets in the Jets’ Week 7 loss to the Dolphins.
https://www.nbcsports.com/adonai-mitchel.analysis: To add insult to injury, Mitchell had a two-point conversion catch called back because of a penalty. Omar Cooper Jr. once again stole the show, reeling in several long catches en route to his second 100-yard game in a row. Playing in his first game in over a month, Mitchell did not appear awfully involved in the team’s game plan. The hope will be that he earns more opportunities next week, but Cooper Jr. may have already cemented himself as the team’s No. 2 receiver. Mitchell will be stuck in the WR5 ranks when he takes on the Raiders next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/adonai-mitchel.headline: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Adonai Mitchell (finger) will play in Week 7 against the Dolphins.
https://www.nbcsports.com/adonai-mitchel.analysis: Mitchell has been sidelined since injuring his finger in preparation for the Jets’ Week 3 game against the Lions. It was incredibly unfortunate time for Mitchell and his fantasy managers, as his injury came just days after he went for 6-63-0 on 12 targets against the Packers. Mitchell’s return could complicate things for Omar Cooper’s fantasy managers after Cooper broke out for 6-103-1 against the Patriots last week. The Jets rank 13th in the league in plays run from 11-personnel (209) through the first six weeks of the season, which means both Mitchell and Cooper should see plenty of snaps. That said, neither player should be viewed as anything more than a WR3/FLEX play until we see how the target distribution looks with both players active.

https://www.nbcsports.com/adonai-mitchel.headline: Adonai Mitchell (finger) was limited on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/adonai-mitchel.analysis: It is too early to say whether Mitchell and his surgically repaired finger will be ready to face the Dolphins this week. He is a worthwhile bench stash, though. Mitchell played well early in the year, pre-injury and pre-breakout from rookie Omar Cooper. It is unclear whether Mitchell will return to the No. 2 wide receiver role or if he will be asked to unseat the youngster.

https://www.nbcsports.com/adonai-mitchel.headline: Adonai Mitchell (finger) was limited in Wednesday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/adonai-mitchel.analysis: Mitchell has missed the past four weeks with a finger injury that required a “small procedure” to fix. Though a limited practice today doesn’t guarantee he will be back for Week 7, it’s a big step in the right direction. Mitchell had nine catches for 123 yards in his first two appearances this year. If he’s able to return this week, he would at least earn a spot on the WR3/4 border versus the Dolphins.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/garrett-wi.headline: Garrett Wilson caught 7-of-14 targets for 106 yards in the Jets’ Week 10 loss to the Bills.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/garrett-wi.analysis: No other Jets player had more than seven targets, so Wilson was the clear focus of the passing attack. That continued when Cade Klubnik came into the game as well. Wilson made a few tough catches and was targeted twice in the end zone as well. Unfortunately, the wide receiver was also charged with a fumble on a botched hook-and-ladder play where he was hit as he was attempting the pitch, which went astray and was recovered by the Bills. Wilson remains the clear top option in this passing attack and could still be a low-end WR2 with Klubnik under center next week against the Chargers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/garrett-wi.headline: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports Garrett Wilson cleared the NFL’s concussion protocol and will play in Week 10 against the Bills.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/garrett-wi.analysis: Wilson missed Week 9 because of the concussion but has cleared the league’s concussion protocol ahead of today’s game. Jets coach Aaron Glenn told reporters on Friday he expected Wilson to play, so this doesn’t come as much of a surprise. In a potential shootout with the Bills, Wilson will push for a high-end WR2 designation this week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/garrett-wi.headline: Garrett Wilson (concussion) is questionable to play in Week 10 against the Bills.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/garrett-wi.analysis: All three of the Jets’ starting wide receivers are questionable to play, though Wilson practiced in full practice and is expected to play. Wilson could handle a hefty workload if he is indeed cleared to play, as expected, and one or two of the others are limited or ruled out. Wilson is a WR2 this week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/garrett-wi.headline: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said he is “confident” that Garrett Wilson (concussion) will play in Week 10 against the Bills.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/garrett-wi.analysis: Glenn said Wilson has one more step to clear before he is out of the league’s concussion protocol. Wilson missed last week’s game against the Chiefs due to his brain injury, but has practiced in a limited capacity twice this week and is trending toward a return. We will get a final update on Wilson once he has officially cleared the protocol, but fantasy managers can start him as a mid-to-high-end WR2 in a game that could feature plenty of points against a high-powered Bills offense.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/garrett-wi.headline: Garrett Wilson (concussion) was limited in Thursday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/garrett-wi.analysis: Wilson still needs to be officially cleared from concussion protocol to play, but two limited sessions have him with a real chance to be active in Week 10 after missing Week 9. If he can play, Wilson will likely be an upside fantasy WR2 against the Bills.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/garrett-wi.headline: ESPN’s Rich Cimini reports the 49ers and Chiefs “were interested” in Garrett Wilson ahead of the trade deadline.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/garrett-wi.analysis: The Jets made it clear they were not moving Wilson early in the process, so we can’t imagine trade talks between them and either team made it very far. Cimini notes that the Jets could revisit a Wilson trade in the offseason. Wilson told reporters earlier this year that he loves it in New York, but he loves winning more. The Jets haven’t done much of that since Wilson was drafted. This will be a storyline to watch in the offseason, though we suspect he’ll remain in New York for the foreseeable future.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/garrett-wi.headline: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said he’s “very hopeful” Garrett Wilson (concussion) will play in Week 10 against the Bills.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/garrett-wi.analysis: Wilson was sidelined in last week’s loss to Kansas City with the head injury he sustained in Week 8. Omar Cooper, Jr. functioned as the team’s top receiver with Wilson sidelined while Adonai Mitchell couldn’t reel in any of his seven targets from Geno Smith. Wilson would be a top-24 option in Week 10 against Buffalo if he can return to action. The Bills secondary allows the 13th highest fantasy points per target to boundary wideouts this season.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/garrett-wi.headline: Jets declared Garrett Wilson, Tim Patrick, Nahshon Wright, Joseph Ossai, Trevin Wallace, Kohl Levao, and Blake Freeland inactive for Week 9 against the Chiefs.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/garrett-wi.analysis: Wilson suffered a head injury last week and did not practice this week as he remained in the NFL’s concussion protocol. Look for Omar Cooper, Jr. and Adonai Mitchell to see more routes and targets against a tough KC secondary. Mitchell is likely to function as the team’s top wideout with Wilson sidelined.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/garrett-wi.headline: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Garrett Wilson (concussion) will not play in Week 9 against the Chiefs.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/garrett-wi.analysis: Wilson has not practiced this week and has now been ruled out for Sunday’s game against the Chiefs. Wilson has caught 43 passes for 527 yards and three touchdowns this season and saw 12 targets in last week’s loss to the Raiders. His absence means both Adonai Mitchell and Omar Cooper should see expanded roles, but both players will be hard to trust as anything more than WR3s against a stout Chiefs defense. In addition to Wilson, the Jets also ruled out LB Trevin Wallace (groin) for Week 9.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/garrett-wi.headline: Garrett Wilson (concussion) did not practice Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/garrett-wi.analysis: Wilson did not practice on Wednesday and will go down as a DNP today as well. He is a long-shot to suit up for the Jets’ Week 9 game against the Chiefs. His absence will free up targets for Adonai Mitchell and Omar Cooper Jr. The two have alternated spike weeks and zeroes over their past two games. Now both should have stable fantasy floors for at least one game.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/emari-deme.headline: Emari Demercado rushed seven times for 16 yards in Houston’s Week 10 loss to the Browns.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/emari-deme.analysis: 13 of those yards came on one carry. Demercado saw the bulk of the opportunities with Woody Marks (concussion) sidelined in the third quarter. Both Demercado’s history and the broader history of Texans running backs over the past several years would tell you there’s little fantasy value in him next week assuming that he becomes their main ballcarrier. Nevertheless, with six teams on bye, he’ll be a reasonable FLEX play against the Colts if David Montgomery remains sidelined.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/emari-deme.headline: Texans claimed Emari Demercado, formerly of the Cowboys, off waivers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/emari-deme.analysis: Demercado will need to contribute on special teams to be active on game day, and he might also need David Montgomery (groin) to remain sidelined after the Week 8 bye. Demercado does not need to be added in 12-team leagues.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/emari-deme.headline: Cowboys waived Emari Demercado.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/emari-deme.analysis: It’s not the first time they’ve done so this season, so we’re not exactly sure that Demercado is done here. However he was a healthy scratch last night and the Cowboys are looking at activating some players off IR, so it’s possible if Demercado stays it’ll be as part of the practice squad.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/emari-deme.headline: Cowboys declared WR KaVontae Turpin, LB Dee Winters, OT Drew Shelton, OLB Tyrus Wheat, and RB Emari Demercado inactive for Week 7 against the Eagles.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/emari-deme.analysis: No real surprises here after KaVontae Turpin was ruled out earlier in the week, with the biggest impact being how the team will handle kick and punt returns on special teams. The Cowboys continue to inch closer to full strength as they near the half way point in the regular season, desperately needing a win over the shorthanded Eagles to keep pace in the NFC East.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/emari-deme.headline: ESPN’s Todd Archer reports the Cowboys are expected to re-sign RB Emari Demercado.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/emari-deme.analysis: He’ll apparently get a 53-man roster spot after some roster machinations over the next few days. Demercado has lost the backup job to Tyler Goodson and doesn’t need to factor into any fantasy calculations at this time.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/emari-deme.headline: Cowboys waived RB Emari Demercado.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/emari-deme.analysis: Tyler Goodson has had the RB2 role for the past couple of weeks and is set to continue now that Demercado was waived to make room for Tyler Smith to come off injured reserve. Demercado has now been waived twice in two months, and though he may be claimed again, he could also wind up on a practice squad next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/emari-deme.headline: KPRC2’s Aaron Wilson reports the Cowboys are signing RB Tyler Goodson off the Falcons’ practice-squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/emari-deme.analysis: Goodson will backfill the roster spot lost to placing Malik Davis on IR at the end of last week. It’s unclear whether Emari Demercado or Goodson would be the head of a committee if Javonte Williams were injured, as both of them showed up with the Cowboys after last cuts. Neither player is a must-roster as things stand.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/emari-deme.headline: ESPN’s Todd Archer reports that Cowboys Malik Davis (hip) will have surgery and be placed on injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/emari-deme.analysis: It is unclear whether this is a season-ending injury or if Davis has a chance to return later in the year. ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler reported earlier that the Cowboys were “bracing for an extended absence” and that a source told him, “it’s bad.” It sounds like Davis’ 2026 season may be over. Cowboys RB Emari Demercado now sits behind starting RB Javonte Williams, and RB Israel Abanikanda is on the practice squad.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/emari-deme.headline: ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler reports that the Cowboys “are bracing for an extended absence” after RB Malik Davis suffered a hip injury on Friday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/emari-deme.analysis: Regarding Davis’ injury, Fowler’s source said simply, “it’s bad.” The Cowboys’ No. 2 running back is undergoing further testing, but we expect them to place him on injured reserve before long. The Cowboys waived RB Jaydon Blue and RB Phil Mafah last month. Blue has since signed with the Eagles’ practice squad. The Cowboys have RB Emari Demercado on the active roster behind RB Javonte Williams. Currently, only RB Israel Abanikanda is on the practice squad in Dallas.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/emari-deme.headline: DLLS Sports’ Clarence Hill Jr. reports Malik Davis was carted off the field on Friday with an injury.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/emari-deme.analysis: Hill was quickly ruled out for Week 1. Dallas cut Phil Mafah and Jaydon Blue at the end of camp, briefly leaving Davis as the only backup running back on their roster. They eventually signed Emari Demercado after he was released by Kansas City. If the injury is serious, the Cowboys could bring either Mafah or Blue back, given their familiarity with the system. The Dallas Morning News’ Calvin Watkins reported shortly afterward that Davis has suffered a hip injury, though no further details were given.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/josh-downs.headline: Josh Downs caught 4-of-5 targets for 53 yards and a touchdown in the Chiefs’ Week 10 win over the Falcons.
Chiefs acquired WR Josh Downs and a 2027 seventh-round pick from the Colts for a 2027 fourth-round pick and a 2027 fifth-round pick.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/josh-downs.analysis: It was an obvious fit. Downs will slot in as Kansas City’s No. 2 wideout behind Rashee Rice and his fantasy stock receives a slight upgrade — though we felt like we’ve spent all year saying that and never seeing any actual returns for it — while Xavier Worthy moves back to the undesirable FLEX shadow zone. The Colts had to make this trade as Downs was a free agent at year’s end, but it has left them with a completely indecipherable wideout room. Ashton Dulin is perhaps the No. 1 target Daniel Jones has outside of Tyler Warren and Jonathan Taylor.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/josh-downs.headline: ESPN’s Stephen Holder believes Josh Downs “is finding that he is best suited to play the role he has always played.”
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/josh-downs.analysis: The Colts have given Downs the opportunity to expand his offensive involvement this year, but he has struggled to capitalize on it without Alec Piece (heel) on the field to keep defenses honest. Downs reportedly asked for a trade roughly two weeks ago, and per Holder, the relationship between Downs and the Colts isn’t “the best” right now. If they can’t get adequate trade value, they may choose to keep him, while also using the lack of a substantial offer as a counterpoint to his recent disgruntlement. Stay tuned.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/josh-downs.headline: Josh Downs caught 3-of-6 targets for 24 yards in the Colts’ Week 9 loss to the Cowboys.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/josh-downs.analysis: Downs saw numerous snaps in coverage by his younger brother, Caleb Downs, and was unable to return a usable fantasy outing for the seventh time in nine appearances for the Colts this season. The subject of significant trade speculation ahead of Tuesday’s trade deadline, Downs appears likely to be headed for a change of scenery in a contract year, with the Colts reportedly already holding an offer in hand. More to come from one of fantasy’s most disappointing mid-round selections.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/josh-downs.headline: ESPN’s Adam Schefter reports the Colts have told teams they’ve received an offer of a fourth-round pick for WR Josh Downs.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/josh-downs.analysis: The Colts’ original asking price for Downs, who has requested a trade, was a third-round pick. Indianapolis has told teams they already have an offer of a fourth-round pick for the 25-year-old receiver, who is in the last year of his rookie contract. Downs is probably one of the more likelier players to be traded ahead of the deadline. Teams have also called the Colts about Keenan Allen, though he’s unlikely to bring back a similar trade return given his age.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/josh-downs.headline: Sports Illustrated’s Albert Breer reports that Josh Downs “leads the wide receiver market” ahead of the NFL trade deadline.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/josh-downs.analysis: Downs’ 2026 season has fallen short of expectations, but perhaps he has a chance to rebound. Breer believes acquiring Downs would “probably” cost a fourth-round pick. He is “one of a number of receivers on the market” at the moment, with the Chiefs and Steelers among the teams looking for help at the position. Breer adds that the 49ers are “open” to adding a wide receiver as well, but with their positional health improving, San Francisco is “less desperate than they were a couple of weeks ago.” The Steelers’ wide receiver corps might be too muddled for Downs to meaningfully increase his productivity, but landing in Kansas City or San Francisco would likely be good for him.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/josh-downs.headline: The Athletic’s Nate Atkins believes the Rams must find a way to trade for a wide receiver before the November 10th deadline.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/josh-downs.analysis: The Rams’ resources are thin. They already traded away their 2027 first- and second-round picks, their 2028 second-round pick and their 2029 third-round pick. They also have just $8,000 in 2026 salary cap space, so restructuring the potential new add’s deal would be required. Atkins believes the Rams should consider Josh Downs as the top option due to his ability to beat man coverage and contribute as a returner. Other options, according to Atkins, include Calvin Ridley, Keenan Allen and Jauan Jennings, “for the likely cost of a Day 3 pick.”

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/josh-downs.headline: A to Z Sports’ Charles Goldman reports that if the Chiefs trade for a wide receiver, the team “would like to acquire a long-term fixture rather than a one-year rental.”
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/josh-downs.analysis: Chiefs coach Andy Reid told reporters today that general manager Brett Veach has been constantly sharing potential trade targets with the coaching staff for about a month. According to Goldman, the Chiefs could also target additions along the offensive and defensive lines, but he believes the team would “likely have to acquire a receiver through other means” before focusing on the trenches. There aren’t many free agency options right now, though, so it is unclear how this scenario would play out. Goldman notes that Josh Downs and Brian Thomas Jr. “have surfaced in trade discussions.” He does not think the Chiefs will make a move before Sunday, though a move early next week, before the November 10th trade deadline, is still possible.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/josh-downs.headline: Josh Downs caught 4-of-5 targets for 23 yards and a touchdown in the Colts’ Week 8 loss to the Jaguars.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/josh-downs.analysis: Downs’ score was something of a pity touchdown in a game the Colts were trailing 35-0 at the 3:59 mark of the third quarter. Jacksonville’s defense had a rare mixup, and Downs was roaming free in the end zone. Amazingly, it was his first touchdown of the year. That speaks to just how dire things have been for Downs in an offense with an ineffective Daniel Jones and ageless Keenan Allen. Downs, who of course must be held responsible for his own mediocre play, will have no shot at a 2026 fantasy revival unless he’s subject to a change-of-scenery trade ahead of the Nov. 10 deadline.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/josh-downs.headline: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport said he “wouldn’t be surprised” if the Chiefs trade for a wide receiver.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/josh-downs.analysis: Rapoport then named Josh Downs and Brian Thomas Jr. as players to keep an eye on. Both wideouts are in the midst of down years and their teams have already leaked that they are on the trade block. Thomas Jr. would hopefully unlock the once-vaunted Patrick Mahomes deep ball. Downs, on the other hand, would be another underneath weapon for a passing attack that his simply asking too much of Rashee Rice right now. Both players’ fantasy stock would skyrocket via a trade.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kc-concepc.headline: KC Concepcion caught 3-of-8 passes for 21 yards in Cleveland’s Week 10 win over the Texans, adding a six-yard touchdown rush on his only carry.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kc-concepc.analysis: He dropped a perfectly-placed deep ball in the first quarter and was seen riding an exercise bike on the sideline afterwards, but he got off the bench and scored on a misdirection touchdown play in the third quarter. With a 129-yard game and two touchdowns mixed among his last four games, Concepcion should likely remain in the WR3 mix as we hit his bye week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kc-concepc.headline: KC Concepcion caught 4-of-6 targets for 85 yards and a touchdown in the Browns’ Week 9 loss to the Saints.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kc-concepc.analysis: Concepcion’s day appeared to be over late in the third quarter when he limped off the field with a non-contact injury. Concepcion was unable to put any weight on his leg and needed to be helped off the field by trainers. He was then on the field to return a punt ahead of Cleveland’s next drive. The rookie made it stunningly clear that he was fine in the fourth quarter with a 64-yard receiving touchdown. Sanders hit him for a long gain and Concepcion outran two Saints defenders for his first career touchdown. With 221 receiving yards over his past three games, Concepcion is heating up just in time for the fantasy playoff hunt. He will be in the WR3 mix versus the Texans next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kc-concepc.headline: KC Concepcion caught 3-of-4 targets for 37 yards in the Browns’ Week 8 loss to the Steelers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kc-concepc.analysis: Deshaun Watson threw for 324 yards, but almost all of those were to tight ends and running backs. Concepcion did have a nice gain of 24 yards on one catch but was rarely involved apart from that. He did play 55 of the team’s 67 snaps and run a route on 44 of their 49 dropbacks, so the role is great, but the offense and quarterback play will likely keep him an inconsistent fantasy option.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kc-concepc.headline: KC Concepcion caught 8-of-10 targets for 129 yards in the Browns’ Week 7 win against the Titans, adding three rushes for 23 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kc-concepc.analysis: The Browns slot man shredded the Tennessee secondary from start to finish. Coming into the game with a season-high of 64 receiving yards, Concepcion eclipsed that mark in the second quarter and didn’t look back. He continually shed tacklers against a low-effort Titans defense and functioned as the centerpiece of the Cleveland passing game. He led the Browns in targets, mostly seeing designed short-area throws from Deshaun Watson. In a Browns offense with a top-10 neutral pass rate, Concepcion should be a weekly top-36 option in PPR formats. He’ll get the Steelers in Week 8.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kc-concepc.headline: KC Concepcion (calf/quad) is not on Cleveland’s final Week 7 injury report.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kc-concepc.analysis: Concepcion should be treated as a PPR WR3/WR4 tweener this week in a good matchup against the Titans. With Denzel Boston also active, we likely won’t be seeing any major explosions here. Concepcion-reliant managers would accept any explosion at this point as he’s found it hard to crack 50 receiving yards so far.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kc-concepc.headline: KC Concepcion (calf/quad) was limited on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kc-concepc.analysis: The Browns’ short-area target earner is banged up, but he still has a chance to play in Week 7 against the Titans. Ideally, Concepcion will upgrade to full participation tomorrow. If he remains limited, he may end up being listed with a questionable tag. Stay tuned.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kc-concepc.headline: KC Concepcion (calf/quad) was limited on Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kc-concepc.analysis: The rookie wide receiver has been awfully banged up over the past two weeks. He suffered a concussion in Week 5, yet managed to play in Week 6. Unfortunately, he did not leave the contest unscathed, picking up two lower-body injuries. Hopefully, he resumes practicing fully tomorrow.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kc-concepc.headline: KC Concepcion caught 4-of-6 targets for 37 yards in the Browns’ Week 6 win over the Ravens, adding two carries for two additional yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kc-concepc.analysis: Concepcion’s six targets led all Browns players, while his 37 receiving yards were good for second-most behind Jerry Jeudy. Concepcion’s biggest play of the game came on a 17-yard reception in the third quarter that helped set up the Browns’ first scoring drive of the afternoon. Concepcion had a red zone carry inside the Ravens’ 10-yard line that resulted in only a one-yard gain, but it’s always good to see his coaches trusting him in the valuable areas of the field. We are still waiting on his first breakout game, but the volume continues to be encouraging. Concepcion will be a fringe WR3/WR4 next week against the Titans.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kc-concepc.headline: Browns coach Todd Monken said KC Concepcion (concussion) has cleared protocol and will play in Cleveland’s Week 6 game against the Ravens.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kc-concepc.analysis: Concepcion will have some low-end WR3/FLEX appeal with four teams on bye in PPR leagues. He simply hasn’t been able to find much space with his opportunities so far, with two 25-yard catches and 16 other catches that went for just 99 yards in his first five weeks of action.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kc-concepc.headline: KC Concepcion (concussion) was limited in Thursday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kc-concepc.analysis: He’s still in concussion protocol, but it looks like he’ll have at least some chance of clearing before Sunday’s game against the Ravens. Concepcion would struggle to be more than a FLEX option here even if healthy, so fantasy managers should probably look at alternatives this week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kc-concepc.headline: KC Concepcion (concussion) will practice Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/kc-concepc.analysis: It’s a remarkable turn after Concepcion was knocked out cold on the field in Week 5 against the Jets. If Concepcion is able to practice in the coming days he should be active for Week 6 against the Ravens. The rookie leads the Cleveland offense with a 23 percent target per route rate, used primarily as a gadget player near the line of scrimmage. He would be a flex option in PPR formats if he suits up against Baltimore.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalen-coke.headline: Jalen Coker did not catch any of his four targets in the Panthers’ Week 10 win against the Saints.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalen-coke.analysis: Coker had one rush for three yards but was otherwise invisible. The usually pass-first Panthers went mega run-heavy against the Saints, limiting targets for every Carolina pass catcher. Coker, who ran a route on 33 of 36 Panthers drop backs, was seen yelling in frustration on the sideline in the second half. Coker has done almost nothing since his Week 1 explosion against the Bears. He has four or fewer receptions in five games this season. Coker will be a deep league flex in Week 11 against Baltimore.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalen-coke.headline: Jalen Coker caught 4-of-5 targets for 29 yards in the Panthers’ Week 9 loss to the Broncos.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalen-coke.analysis: Coker is now really going through it over his past three games, managing just seven total catches for 74 yards and a touchdown. If there’s “good” news, it’s that it has been an offensive-wide slump in Carolina, not just Coker. He and everyone else has a premium Week 10 get-right spot in the Saints, though Coker is starting to look more like a WR3 than the WR2 he was showing out as earlier in the year.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalen-coke.headline: Jalen Coker caught 2-of-5 targets for 38 yards and a touchdown in the Panthers’ Week 8 loss to the Packers while also losing a fumble.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalen-coke.analysis: Coker’s fumble came on the last play of the game as the Panthers played pitchy woo woo in their attempt to tie the game. The 24-year-old didn’t have a catch in the first half, but salvaged his fantasy day — to a point, anyway — with a 26-yard touchdown from Bryce Young. The 24-year-old has just three catches over the last two games, and he’ll try and get things going against the Broncos in Week 9.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalen-coke.headline: Jalen Coker (shoulder) was removed from the injury report and will play in Week 8 against the Packers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalen-coke.analysis: Coker was at little risk of missing tomorrow’s game after getting in a full practice on Tuesday. He was listed as a full participant again today before being cleared for action. Despite the quiet Week 7 showing, which saw Coker catch just one pass, fantasy managers should still treat him as a WR2 for Week 8.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalen-coke.headline: Jalen Coker (shoulder) practiced in full on Tuesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalen-coke.analysis: Seems there’s little doubt that Coker will play on Thursday night. He’ll likely be removed from the injury report on Wednesday. Even after last week’s fiasco he likely belongs in the WR2 ranks.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalen-coke.headline: Panthers listed Jalen Coker (shoulder) as limited on Monday’s estimated injury report.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalen-coke.analysis: The Panthers won’t have their first official practice until Tuesday, but Coker would have been limited on Monday had the team been on the field. Coker caught one pass for nine yards in Week 7’s loss to the Buccaneers. His struggles came on a day when the entire Panthers offense was stymied for much of the day, so hopefully he’ll be in line to bounce back against the Packers on Thursday if he is active.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalen-coke.headline: Jalen Coker caught 1-of-4 targets for nine yards in the Panthers’ Week 7 loss to the Bucs.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalen-coke.analysis: Coker was also the intended target on the first of Bryce Young’s two interceptions. The wideout fell down, leading to the miscue. It was simply a nightmarish day for the Panthers’ offense, who also watched Young cough up a fumble-six. With the Panthers trailing 33-6 at halftime and 43-6 at the 10:21 mark of the fourth, the first-team offense sat for the game’s final 10 minutes. A disaster for fantasy managers, but likely a short-lived one with the Panthers heading to Green Bay for a short-week Thursday night matchup with the Pack. Coker must still be fired up as a WR2 for that one.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalen-coke.headline: Jalen Coker caught 6-of-13 passes for 97 yards in the Panthers’ Week 6 win over the Eagles.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalen-coke.analysis: Coker missed Week 4 with a quad injury but was able to heal up over the bye week and play a full complement of snaps in Week 6. Initial reports had him playing 59 of the team’s 79 snaps and running a route on 39 of 46 dropbacks, which was second most on the team. He also led the team in targets, catches, and receiving yards. He’s a rock-solid WR2 against the Bucs next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalen-coke.headline: Jalen Coker (quad) is practicing in full for Week 6 against the Eagles.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalen-coke.analysis: Panthers coach Dave Canales told reporters earlier this week that Coker was returning from both quad and ankle injuries, though the team is only listing the quad issue. We take this as a good sign for his overall health. Coker can be treated as a WR2 in his first game back, facing an Eagles defense that struggles to cover opposing slot receivers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalen-coke.headline: Panthers coach Dave Canales said Jalen Coker (quad) is “on track” to play in Carolina’s Week 6 game against the Eagles.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalen-coke.analysis: Coker was spotted practicing on Tuesday (there will be no injury report for this one) and seems like he’s well on track to return. He’ll be a fringe WR2/WR3 against the Eagles in Week 6.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalen-coke.headline: Panthers WR Jalen Coker (quadricep) is inactive for Week 4 against the Lions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jalen-coke.analysis: This was though to be the most likely scenario after head coach Dave Canales told reporters Friday that the team would elevate Ja’Seem Reed if the belief was that Coker could not go on Sunday Night Football. Reed was, in fact, elevated Saturday and Coker was declared inactive. Brycen Tremaine appears to be in line for a featured role after playing 81 percent of the team’s offensive snaps a week ago. Expect John Metchie to also see additional snaps and opportunities, while David Moore could see package usage on the perimeter. Also inactive for the Panthers are TE Ja’Tavion Sanders, QB Haynes King, G Damien Lewis, OT Albert Reese, and DT Cam Jackson.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/denzel-bos.headline: Denzel Boston caught 1-of-2 targets for 16 yards in Cleveland’s Week 10 win over the Texans.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/denzel-bos.analysis: He did manage some good punt returns, but the Browns weren’t able to get their deep-ball offense going and mostly let Derek Stingley take Boston out of the game. Boston isn’t necessarily a must-hold through shallow leagues at the bye, as he’s been held under 50 yards in five of his last six games, but the target count has been stronger than this dud generally, and he was likely playing hurt here.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/denzel-bos.headline: Denzel Boston (toe) is active for Cleveland’s Week 10 game against the Texans.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/denzel-bos.analysis: He got in just one practice and was spotted in a boot at times before being dubbed questionable, but will be a reasonable WR3 play against a Texans defense missing a few pieces. Inactive for the Browns are S Ronnie Hickman (concussion), C Parker Brailsford, QB Dillon Gabriel (third quarterback), QB Taylen Green, CB Noah Ignioghene and LB Justin Jefferson.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/denzel-bos.headline: ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler reports Denzel Boston (toe) is expected to play in Week 10 against the Texans.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/denzel-bos.analysis: Boston will likely go through a workout in the morning to determine his status, but he appears to be on the right side of questionable for now. He was held out of the Browns’ first two practices of the week before getting in a limited session on Friday. Barring a setback ahead of kickoff, Boston is back in the WR3 mix for Week 10.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/denzel-bos.headline: Denzel Boston (toe) is questionable for Cleveland’s Week 10 game against the Texans.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/denzel-bos.analysis: He made it back on to the practice field on Friday, so he’s probably on the optimistic side of questionable at this point. Todd Monken did say at his Friday presser that Boston is “trending in the right direction.” Boston did miss the first two sessions of the week but has been no stranger to the injury report this year and has tended to gut it out. Boston was seen wearing a walking boot as he left the locker room. He still has a chance to play, but his status is worth monitoring closely.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/denzel-bos.headline: Denzel Boston (toe) did not practice on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/denzel-bos.analysis: This morning, Boston told reporters that he was hoping to resume practicing today. Unfortunately, he was unable to do so. That said, Boston’s toe injury is feeling better and things are “trending up” at the moment. It sounds like the rookie wide receiver has a chance to play in Week 10 against the Texans and would be a WR3/FLEX if so.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/denzel-bos.headline: Denzel Boston (toe) did not practice on Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/denzel-bos.analysis: Boston continues to pick up lower-leg injuries, but last week’s calf issue did not slow him down. The Browns have begun varying Boston’s usage, no longer limiting him to high-variance downfield work. Adding short-to-intermediate opportunities only enhances his outlook. If he can play this weekend, he will be a WR3/FLEX.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/denzel-bos.headline: Denzel Boston caught 6-of-7 targets for 98 yards in the Browns’ Week 9 loss to the Saints.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/denzel-bos.analysis: Like clockwork, Boston beat his man for a massive play again this week. Boston plucked a deep ball right off Kool-Aid McKinstry’s helmet and ran inside the five-yard line for a 60-yard gain early in the third quarter. It was his league-leading fourth catch of 40+ yards this year. Despite operating as a deep threat, Boston went on to lead the Browns in all receiving categories except touchdowns. Boston continues to look like a high-end boundary receiver in the mold of Tee Higgins or Mike Evans. While he’s got a long way to go to match those players, the early returns have been promising. Boston will remain a high-ceiling WR3 when he takes on the Texans next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/denzel-bos.headline: Denzel Boston (calf) was removed from the injury report and will play in Week 9 against the Saints.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/denzel-bos.analysis: Boston will once again play through a lower-body injury. The rookie downfield wide receiver has played unproductively as of late, but he remains a threat to rip off a long gain. He will be catching passes from Shedeur Sanders this weekend. Hopefully, the two form a strong connection quickly.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/denzel-bos.headline: Denzel Boston (calf) was limited on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/denzel-bos.analysis: Boston is on track to face the Saints this week, but lower-body injuries have limited his production since Week 4. The Browns are also likely to have Shedeur Sanders under center, adding an unknown variable to the mix as the two players hone their chemistry. Boston is likely just a boom-bust FLEX.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/denzel-bos.headline: Denzel Boston (calf) was limited in Wednesday’s practice.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/denzel-bos.analysis: A limited designation for the first practice of the week is usually nothing to worry about. We’ll assume as much for now. Boston has been racking up targets and air yards without much to show for it in his box scores over the past month. He hasn’t eclipsed 50 yards in a game since Week 4. A date with New Orleans’ struggling defense should help him get back on track as a WR3 for Week 9.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.headline: Chuba Hubbard had 27 rushes for 92 yards and two touchdowns in the Panthers’ Week 10 win against the Saints, adding five catches for 72 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.analysis: The entire Carolina offense revolved around Hubbard in this one, as the Panthers ditched their pass-heavy approach for an ultra run-heavy offense against a middle New Orleans defense. Hubbard had a couple long plays and a touchdown called back on penalties too. He plodded along for much of the game before exploding for a long gain on a well-designed screen play late in the fourth quarter. Hubbard, who now has seven games with at least 17 rushes, has been one of the most reliable running backs in fantasy this season. That might change a bit when Jonathon Brooks returns from injury, perhaps in Week 11 against the Ravens.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.headline: Chuba Hubbard rushed 16 times for 79 yards in the Panthers’ Week 9 loss to the Broncos, adding four receptions for 17 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.analysis: Hubbard’s 16 totes were his second fewest since Week 2, though fantasy managers will at least take the 96 yards from scrimmage. Handling huge workloads and snap counts, Hubbard hasn’t always maintained his efficiency under such voluminous usage, though we have yet to see any red flags in 2026. He will remain a strong option on the RB1/2 borderline for Week 10 against the Saints.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.headline: Chuba Hubbard rushed 22 times for 81 yards and a touchdown in the Panthers’ Week 8 loss to the Packers, adding seven receptions for 38 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.analysis: Hubbard was easily the most effective offensive player for the Panthers, but that’s at least partially an insult to everyone else as much as it was compliment to him. The tailback was able to make the most of the limited rushing room, and with Bryce Young having zero time to throw the football, he was a frequent target of Young’s checkdowns. Trevor Etienne received just one carry for one yard, meanwhile. Hubbard’s usage makes him a high-end RB2 for Week 9 against the Broncos, even if it’s more floor than ceiling.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.headline: Chuba Hubbard rushed seven times for 33 yards in the Panthers’ 43-13, Week 7 loss to the Bucs, adding four receptions for 27 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.analysis: With Bryce Young committing three turnovers — killing drives and setting up Bucs short fields that took the Panthers out of run-friendly game script — Hubbard had little shot at providing fantasy-friendly returns this afternoon unless he found the end zone late. He did not, with those honors going to “Anthony Tyus III” in garbage time. It was just one of those days in Charlotte. Thankfully the Panthers don’t have long to stew, as they must now get ready for a short-week Thursday evening road date with the Packers. With most Pack — and Panthers — games projecting as shootouts these days, Hubbard will remain safely ensconced in the high-end RB2 ranks.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.headline: Chuba Hubbard rushed 28 times for 120 yards and a touchdown in the Panthers’ Week 6 win over the Eagles.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.analysis: It wasn’t easy for Hubbard, who didn’t have many runs over 10 yards, but he ran hard, broke tackles, and was able to find the end zone in the fourth quarter for a short touchdown run. Still, the Panthers did have some issues running the ball up the gut against the Eagles and continued to do it, rather than try to get Hubbard going on the edge. Trevor Etienne was the only other running back to have a carry in this game, and he had just one rush, so this backfield belongs entirely to Hubbard, which is tremendous for his fantasy value.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.headline: Chuba Hubbard rushed 20 times for 122 yards and two touchdowns in the Panthers’ Week 4 win over the Lions, adding seven yards on one reception.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.analysis: Hubbard’s successes on the ground allowed the Panthers to remain balanced on a night they were without two of their top three wide receivers due to the absences of Jalen Coker and Xavier Legette, cashing in on two scores from 15 and two yards out. Hubbard appears to be locked into an RB1 workload in the absence of Jonathan Brooks, who will be out for 6-8 weeks after undergoing core muscle surgery. His 26 opportunities dwarfed the six of current backup AJ Dillon, the latter of whom gained just seven total yards on six touches. Fantasy managers can start Hubbard with confidence when the team returns from their bye to face the Eagles in Week 6.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.headline: Chuba Hubbard rushed 19 times for 82 yards in the Panthers’ Week 3 loss to the Browns, adding four receptions for 28 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.analysis: With Jonathon Brooks on injured reserve, Hubbard’s 23 touches were nine more than he handled in Week 2, and 10 more than Week 1. Although he ceded a smattering of snaps to new backup AJ Dillon, he was a near every-down player in this road loss. Hubbard lacks high-end fantasy upside, but his floor right now is very much that of a locked-in RB2. That will be especially true for matchups like next week’s date with the defensively-challenged Lions.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.headline: Panthers will host a workout for Austin Ekeler, formerly of the Commanders.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.analysis: Carolina is in need of some backfield reinforcements after losing Jonathon Brooks to a core injury that will leave him sidelined for at least six weeks. AJ Dillon is set to fill in for Brooks while Chub Hubbard presumably continues as the team’s lead back. Ekeler, 31, who hasn’t played since injuring his Achilles last September, could be an emergency running back if Hubbard or Dillon go down with injuries in the coming weeks. First he’ll need to make the squad.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.headline: Chuba Hubbard rushed 12 times for 53 yards in the Panthers’ Week 2 win over the Falcons, adding two catches for 11 yards and a touchdown.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.analysis: Hubbard operated as the Panthers’ unquestioned RB1, out-carrying Jonathon Brooks 12-5. He got on the board early with a touchdown catch near the goal line. It was his second touchdown grab of the year and his third time finding the end zone in total. Brooks also left the game early with a groin injury and his status for Week 3 is up in the air. Hubbard was already going to project for RB2 numbers with Brooks in the middle. He will push to the middle of the RB2 pack if Brooks is out versus the Browns.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.headline: Chuba Hubbard had ten rushes for 49 yards and a touchdown in the Panthers’ Week 1 loss to the Bears, adding three catches for 38 yards and a touchdown.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/chuba-hubb.analysis: Hubbard was the clearcut lead back for the run-heavy Carolina offense. Jonathon Brooks saw five touches on the day, and ran six pass routes for 29 routes for Hubbard, who was the Panthers’ primary red zone back throughout the game. For now Hubbard’s role in the run-first Panthers offense seems secure while the team eases Brooks into action. That could change at some point this season. Hubbard will be a locked-in RB2 option next week against a middling Falcons defense.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jerry-jeud.headline: Jerry Jeudy caught 2-of-4 targets for 74 yards in Cleveland’s Week 10 win over the Texans.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jerry-jeud.analysis: He had a 65-yard field-flipper to get Cleveland their first score of the game. That was about the only deep pass the Browns connected on, but it got them going. Jeudy’s been a reasonable third wideout for the Browns this year but nobody you should consider keeping on fantasy rosters through a bye unless you’re in a very, very deep league.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jerry-jeud.headline: Jerry Jeudy caught 2-of-4 targets for 37 yards in the Browns’ Week 9 loss to the Saints.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jerry-jeud.analysis: Jeudy reeled in a game-changing 30-yard pass on the Browns’ final drive of regulation. The grab eventually set up a tying field goal from Andre Szmyt. While the Browns would go on to lose in overtime, Jeudy’s catch at least gave them a shot at the win. He’s not on the fantasy radar right now, but his occasional big play should be enough to keep the Browns from trading him ahead of Tuesday’s deadline.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jerry-jeud.headline: ESPN’s Adam Schefter named Calvin Ridley as a potential trade candidate.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jerry-jeud.analysis: Schefter threw out several names, many of whom have already been bandied about as trade candidates. Among the lesser-discussed options, he included Jerry Jeudy and Jauan Jennings in addition to Ridley. All three are veteran wideouts who have simply disappeared in the current iterations of their respective offenses. Even with new landing spots in the cards for the trio, none of them are worth holding onto in standard fantasy leagues. Ridley has five catches for 81 yards this year. He is expected to play through his hip injury today.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jerry-jeud.headline: Jerry Jeudy caught all four of his targets for 21 yards in the Browns’ Week 7 win against the Titans.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jerry-jeud.analysis: Jeudy was second on the team in pass routes — behind Denzel Boston — and fourth on the team in targets. This comes after Jeudy’s Week 6 performance against the Ravens in which he went for a season-high 69 yards on four receptions. Jeudy is well behind Boston and KC Concepcion in the pass-catching pecking order and should only be rostered in the deepest leagues for now.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jerry-jeud.headline: Jerry Jeudy caught 4-of-4 targets for 69 yards in the Browns’ Week 6 win over the Ravens.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jerry-jeud.analysis: Jeudy made the most of his limited volume in this one, with his longest play coming on a 33-yard reception on the final drive of the game as the Browns were driving down the field to complete the comeback victory. This was easily the best game of the season for Jeudy, who hadn’t gone for more than 36 yards in any other game this season. He’s seen four or fewer targets in four of his five games played and won’t be on the fantasy radar heading into Week 7 against the Titans.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jerry-jeud.headline: Jordan Schultz reports the Browns would like a third or fourth-round pick for WR Jerry Jeudy but he’s not sure they’ll be able to get it.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jerry-jeud.analysis: We, too, would like to simply be given valuable things for no reason. Jeudy has fallen off the fantasy map enough that we’re now simply blurbing trade possibilities for him. The 27-year-old’s only real fantasy value at this point is hoping he gets traded somewhere where he can get involved again.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jerry-jeud.headline: ESPN’s Adam Schefter reports Jerry Jeudy “could be had” before the trade deadline.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jerry-jeud.analysis: With Denzel Boston and KC Concepcion earning large roles right away, Jeudy has all but vanished from the box scores. He went two games without catching a single pass before bringing down three balls for 36 yards on Thursday night. Jeudy got pushed out of the Browns’ long-term plans on draft night and isn’t even part of the week-to-week game plan at this point.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jerry-jeud.headline: KC Concepcion caught 5-of-8 targets for 64 yards in the Browns’ Week 4 win over the Steelers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jerry-jeud.analysis: Concepcion continues to operate as the primary slot receiver for a Browns team clearly looking to their youth while phasing out veteran Jerry Jeudy, the latter of whom managed three receptions on three targets for 36 yards. Concepcion has yet to lead the team in receiving while working in a short area role, with this the first game thus far which he has gained more then 43 yards. He’ll be a difficult start in fantasy circles when the Browns take on the Jets in Week 5.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jerry-jeud.headline: Jerry Jeudy did not catch his lone target in the Browns’ Week 2 win against the Bucs.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jerry-jeud.analysis: After his two-catch performance in Week 1, Jeudy is off to a roaring start. Denzel Boston has established himself as Cleveland’s de facto No. 1 wideout while KC Concepcion is being force fed the ball on gadget plays near the line of scrimmage. With almost no avenue to fantasy relevance, Jeudy should remain on waiver wires.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jerry-jeud.headline: Browns WR Jerry Jeudy (wrist) is practicing in full for Week 2 against the Buccaneers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/jerry-jeud.analysis: Jeudy is on track to play, but he is seemingly being phased out of the offense. Browns rookie WRs Denzel Boston and KC Concepcion are establishing themselves as impactful starters, and their roles should only grow in the coming weeks. Jeudy should be left on waivers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/khalil-sha.headline: Khalil Shakir caught 2-of-3 targets for 26 yards receiving in the Bills’ Week 10 win over the Jets.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/khalil-sha.analysis: Shakir also added 29 yards rushing on three carries, but two of those were simply screens thrown backwards, so they counted as runs. When you factor that in, Shakir had five targets in this one, which was the second-most of any receiver on the Bills. He remains a safe floor option because of his consistent role in the offense, but there isn’t a big fantasy ceiling here unless he breaks multiple tackles after a short completion.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/khalil-sha.headline: Khalil Shakir caught all four targets for 58 yards in the Bills’ Week 9 win over the Vikings.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/khalil-sha.analysis: Shakir saw his routes capped against the tenacious Minnesota defense, with the Bills increasing their 12- and 13-personnel rates to combat the most blitz-heavy defense in NFL history. He made the most of his opportunities while catching all four targets for a team-leading 58 yards. Even so, Shakir remains unlikely to return usable weekly fantasy production as a near slot-only receiver in the run-first Buffalo offense. He will be nothing more than a bye-week FLEX when the Bilsl take on the Jets in Week 10.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/khalil-sha.headline: Khalil Shakir caught 5-of-6 targets for 64 yards in the Bills’ Week 8 win over the Ravens.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/khalil-sha.analysis: Shakir came out cooking on the Bills’ opening drive, catching passes of 26 and 18 yards to immediately move the ball into Ravens territory. A few plays later, Shakir would haul in a five-yard pass that was initially ruled a touchdown, only to have the call overturned after review when Shakir was shown to have stepped out of bounds near the one-yard line. He would have a quiet afternoon after that first drive, as DJ Moore and Dalton Kincaid were the preferred targets of Josh Allen with both back healthy. Shakir, whose fantasy stock is already fairly low, can likely be left out of lineups in Week 9 against a stout Vikings defense.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/khalil-sha.headline: Khalil Shakir caught 4-of-6 targets for 34 yards and a touchdown in the Bills’ Week 6 win over the Raiders.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/khalil-sha.analysis: Shakir didn’t have an overly productive day through the air in this one, but he did manage to find the end zone for his first touchdown of the season. Shakir scored on a nine-yard screen pass in the second quarter to put the Bills up 13-7. Shakir has now gone for double-digit PPR points in three straight games but will be hard to trust as anything more than a WR4/WR5 in Week 8 when the Bills return from their bye to face the Ravens.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/khalil-sha.headline: Khalil Shakir caught all three targets for 80 yards in the Bills’ Week 5 win over the Rams.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/khalil-sha.analysis: Shakir’s modest target total was primarily a product of a ground-heavy approach from the Bills, who were playing without both DJ Moore and Joshua Palmer. His quiet fantasy outing was quickly remedied through a 57-yard, catch-and-run reception on the team’s second possession of overtime to set up the game-winning, Tyler Bass field goal. Shakir remains a shaky fantasy bet ahead of a Week 6 meeting with the Raiders.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/khalil-sha.headline: Khalil Shakir caught 7-of-8 targets for 82 yards and a fumble in the Bills’ Week 4 loss to the Patriots.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/khalil-sha.analysis: Shakir served as Josh Allen’s safety blanket for much of the first half, but he was quiet for much of the second half. Most of his production came on a 51-yard catch-and-run, where he broke a few tackles and got the Bills into the red zone. On another catch-and-run opportunity, he had the ball punched out by two Patriots defenders for a crucial fumble. Shakir and Allen were also not on the same page on a key third-down pass that led to a punt. The Bills are going to need more from Shakir if DJ Moore (Shoulder) misses any time, but Shakir did play the second-most snaps of any receiver and ran the most routes, so his role is still there.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/khalil-sha.headline: Khalil Shakir caught 1-of-3 targets for six yards in the Bills’ Week 3 win over the Chargers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/khalil-sha.analysis: The Bills’ offense was totally out of sorts in this game, and Shakir was hurt by their inability to get anything going through the air. Still, he played on 45 of their 62 snaps and ran a route on 23 of their 33 dropbacks, the second-most of any wide receiver. He’ll be in for a better game against the Patriots next week, but he remains just a desperation FLEX play right now unless the Bills are headed for a shootout.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/khalil-sha.headline: Khalil Shakir caught 3-of-6 targets for 38 yards in the Bills’ Week 2 win over the Lions.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/khalil-sha.analysis: Shakir continued in a gadgety role for the Bills, primarily working the short areas of the field in addition to receiving snaps out of the backfield. That could change in the immediate future after lead receiver DJ Moore departed in the second quarter with what appeared to be a significant shoulder injury. Even so, Shakir is best left on the waiver wire in all but the deepest fantasy leagues.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/khalil-sha.headline: Khalil Shakir caught 4-of-6 targets for 50 yards in Buffalo’s Week 1 win over the Texans.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/khalil-sha.analysis: The good news is he was healthy enough to play after he was seemingly sidelined towards the end of training camp with something the Bills never disclosed. He played 30-of-57 snaps. The bad news is that if Dalton Kincaid is going to be this involved, it’s not likely that Shakir will be targeted enough to crack the WR3 ranks. A lot can change — and Kincaid isn’t known for his durability — but it was a “meh” debut for Shakir as he fell behind Kincaid and DJ Moore in the passing pecking order.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/khalil-sha.headline: The Athletic’s Joe Buscaglia reports that Bills WR Khalil Shakir (undisclosed) is on the practice field on Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/khalil-sha.analysis: This is good news. Shakir has been sidelined for multiple weeks, rehabbing an undisclosed injury. His return today puts him on track to play in Week 1 against the Texans’ top-tier defense. Whether Shakir can be a reliable FLEX with WR DJ Moore now in Buffalo and TE Dalton Kincaid reportedly set to take on a larger role remains to be seen. Getting back on the field is the first step, though.

https://www.nbcsports.com/kyle-mccord/00.headline: Kyle McCord completed 17-of-32 passes for 209 yards and a fumble in the Dolphins’ 24-22, Week 10 loss to the Colts, adding two carries for four yards and a touchdown.
https://www.nbcsports.com/kyle-mccord/00.analysis: Making his first career start in his NFL debut, McCord had a mix of explosive plays and turnover-worthy plays while taking three sacks on the day. The Dolphins offense committed a false start on the first snap and McCord briefly had his throwing hand looked at after hitting it on a helmet on the Dolphins’ first possession. He missed Greg Dulcich on a fourth down in the red zone in the first half and fumbled for a Colts touchdown to open the second half. McCord was able to hit more explosive plays in the fourth quarter with the Colts’ top two cornerbacks out with injury. He rushed for a touchdown to open the fourth quarter and get the Dolphins within two points. The Dolphins could not finish the comeback, mainly due to kicking woes. McCord showed the desire to put the ball in danger to hunt explosive plays in the second half, a good sign that he can keep a player like Caleb Douglas fantasy-relevant. With six teams on bye, McCord can be considered a QB2 against the Bills for Week 11.

https://www.nbcsports.com/kyle-mccord/00.headline: The Ringer’s Tom Pelissero reports Kyle McCord is set to make his NFL debut against the Colts.
https://www.nbcsports.com/kyle-mccord/00.analysis: McCord! Daniel Jones throwing to Ashton Dulin! All the stars are here in Week 10! Even in an elevated matchup, there’s little reason to believe that McCord will be more than a bottom-five superflex option this week. And this might wind up being one of his good starts, if indeed the Dolphins commit to giving him multiple cracks while Malik Willis is on injured reserve.

https://www.nbcsports.com/kyle-mccord/00.headline: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said the team traded for Kyle McCord to be the team’s No. 2 quarterback, but that he expects recently-claimed Brady Cook to “make a push.”
https://www.nbcsports.com/kyle-mccord/00.analysis: Riveting situation. The main fantasy takeaway here is probably something like “if Malik Willis gets hurt this year, all Dolphins pass-catchers will take major downgrades.”

https://www.nbcsports.com/kyle-mccord/00.headline: Dolphins acquired QB Kyle McCord from the Packers in exchange for a sixth-round pick.
https://www.nbcsports.com/kyle-mccord/00.analysis: The news was first reported by ESPN’s Adam Schefter. The draft pick going to the Packers is a 2028 sixth-round pick. After trading Quinn Ewers to the Jaguars, the Dolphins acquired their new backup QB in McCord, who had an impressive preseason. The Dolphins new GM and HC came from Green Bay this offseason and so did both of the quarterbacks on their active roster in McCord and starter Malik Willis. McCord was a sixth-round pick by the Eagles in the 2025 NFL Draft and is yet to appear in a regular season game.

https://www.nbcsports.com/kyle-mccord/00.headline: Eagles signed RB Audric Estime to their practice squad.
https://www.nbcsports.com/kyle-mccord/00.analysis: The second-year back will get a fresh start in Philadelphia, perhaps eventually pushing A.J. Dillon off the roster. Also on Philadelphia’s practice squad are: LB Chance Campbell, WR Elijah Cooks, G Kenyon Green, TE E.J. Jenkins, CB Brandon Johnson, OLB Patrick Johnson, TE Cameron Latu, WR Terrace Marshall, QB Kyle McCord, CB Parry Nickerson, T Hollin Pierce, OLB Antwaun Powell-Ryland, CB Eli Ricks and S Andre Sam.

https://www.nbcsports.com/kyle-mccord/00.headline: Ohio State freshman QB Kyle McCord completed 13-of-18 for 318 yards, two touchdowns and one interception in Saturday’s 59-7 win over Akron.
https://www.nbcsports.com/kyle-mccord/00.analysis: McCord (6'3"/210) got the start as CJ Stroud got the night off due to a shoulder injury. There is a reason why McCord was a five-star recruit, he looked great. He got the Buckeyes on the board when he hit Chris Olave in the back of the end zone for five yards. He later hit Jaxon Smith-Njigba a little short, but he was able to reach in front of the Akron defender and grab the 34-yard touchdown. His night was over midway through the third quarter as Jack Miller came in with OSU holding a comfortable lead. Even with the great performance by McCord, Stroud is still the guy. Ohio State will travel to Rutgers next Saturday.

https://www.nbcsports.com/kyle-mccord/00.headline: Ohio State freshman QB Kyle McCord will start Saturday’s game against Akron, per Big Ten Network.
https://www.nbcsports.com/kyle-mccord/00.analysis: With freshman starter C.J. Stroud down due to a shoulder injury, either McCord (6'3/210) or Jack Miller was in line to start Saturday night. McCord won out in the end, but it would not come as a surprise if Miller got some reps as well. Stroud is available, but only in case of an emergency.

https://www.nbcsports.com/kyle-mccord/00.headline: Ohio State freshman QB Kyle McCord will compete in practice for the start against Akron.
https://www.nbcsports.com/kyle-mccord/00.analysis: Coach Ryan Day said backup QB McCord (6'3"/210) and third-string QB Jack Miller will compete in practice for the starting role against Akron on Saturday. Cj Stroud (shoulder) will be an emergency-only option. Whether it’s McCord or Miller who get the start this week for the Buckeyes, it’s a one-time deal.

https://www.nbcsports.com/kyle-mccord/00.headline: Ohio State HC Ryan Day has not made a decision on a backup quarterback as of now.
https://www.nbcsports.com/kyle-mccord/00.analysis: CJ Stroud is obviously this team’s starter and has been mentioned several times as early as this past offseason as a player who could become one of the top prospects at his position in the future granted that he shows to be what some have projected he can be as the season goes on. Buckeyes HC Ryan Day has said that he has not settled on a backup QB yet, though freshman Kyle McCord has largely been the projected favorite for the No. 2 spot. Ohio State also has junior QB J.P. Andrade, senior Jagger LaRoe and freshman Jack Miller are also on the depth chart at the position.

https://www.nbcsports.com/kyle-mccord/00.headline: Ohio State true freshman Kyle McCord is warming up as the second-string QB ahead of the Minnesota clash.
https://www.nbcsports.com/kyle-mccord/00.analysis: McCord, a highly recruited five-star QB, seems to have seized the second string job over fellow freshman Jack Miller. McCord reportedly battled close with starter CJ Stroud but ultimately fell short.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dylan-samp.headline: Dylan Sampson rushed four times for six yards in Cleveland’s Week 10 win over the Texans, adding four catches for 31 yards on six targets.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dylan-samp.analysis: Sampson outsnapped Quinshon Judkins 35-32 as the Browns had to dig their way out of a 17-0 hole against the Texans defense. Since returning from injured reserve Sampson has generated 12 catches for 121 yards through the air, not unusable numbers even if they’re not exactly a PPR scam. Sampson can be dropped in shallower leagues during Cleveland’s Week 11 bye.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dylan-samp.headline: Dylan Sampson rushed eight times for 21 yards in the Browns’ Week 9 loss to the Saints, adding three catches for 27 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dylan-samp.analysis: Per usual, Sampson did the bulk of his damage through the air, especially in PPR leagues. He saw six targets compared to just one for Quinshon Judkins. Sampson’s role is good for a few weekly PPR points, but his lack of rushing production makes a ceiling outcome almost impossible. He’ll be a viable RB4 fantasy option when the Browns take on the Texans next week.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dylan-samp.headline: Dylan Sampson caught six passes for 62 yards in the Browns’ Week 8 loss to the Steelers.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dylan-samp.analysis: Sampson only had one carry in this game, gaining seven yards, but he was third on the team in targets and second on the team in receiving yards. Early reports show that he played 11 more snaps than Quinson Judkins and ran a route on 29 of the team’s 49 dropbacks, compared to seven for Judkins. Sampson is very clearly the pass-catching back in Cleveland, and a good one too. If this team is going to be trailing often, he’ll have PPR value.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dylan-samp.headline: Dylan Sampson (knee) is not on Cleveland’s final Week 8 injury report.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dylan-samp.analysis: Sampson got in two full sessions to close out the week and should be a low-end RB3/FLEX play in limited snaps against the Steelers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dylan-samp.headline: Dylan Sampson (knee) practiced in full on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dylan-samp.analysis: He played last week just fine, so it seems like he was just given a bit of a breather on Wednesday during a limited session. Sampson should handle 5-10 touches for the Browns on Sunday against the Steelers.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dylan-samp.headline: Dylan Sampson (knee) was limited on Wednesday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dylan-samp.analysis: The Browns’ No. 2 running back played through his knee injury effectively last week, totaling 79 scrimmage yards and three receptions against the Titans. He should be expected to continue playing productively on his limited workload moving forward. He is not a must-start player in Week 8 against the Steelers, but he belongs in the FLEX conversation.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dylan-samp.headline: Dylan Sampson had six rushes for 45 yards in the Browns’ Week 7 win against the Titans, adding three catches for 34 yards.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dylan-samp.analysis: In his first action of 2026, Sampson looked spry and explosive as the Browns’ No. 2 back behind Quinshon Judkins, who totaled over 100 yards and scored two touchdowns on the day. Sampson, meanwhile, logged more pass routes and targets than Judkins. It would appear Sampson is the next guy up in the Cleveland backfield if Judkins misses time in the coming weeks. He should be rostered in most 12-team leagues as a bench stash.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dylan-samp.headline: Browns activated RB Dylan Sampson (knee) from injured reserve.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dylan-samp.analysis: Sampson was limited in practice throughout the week and listed as questionable for Week 7 against the Titans. Now that he’s officially been activated from injured reserve, he’s likely to be Cleveland’s change-of-pace back behind Quinshon Judkins this week. Sampson is worth stashing on fantasy benches, but is truly just a desperation FLEX play coming off a knee injury that’s sidelined him since Week 1.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dylan-samp.headline: Dylan Sampson (knee/IR) is questionable for Cleveland’s Week 7 game against the Titans.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dylan-samp.analysis: If active, he will be a change-up back for Quinshon Judkins, who is not carrying a status this week. Coming off a long-term injury, it would be a real leap of faith to put Sampson in a FLEX role this week, even against the Titans.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dylan-samp.headline: Dylan Sampson (knee) was limited on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dylan-samp.analysis: The Browns could get their receiving specialist back in the lineup this week, though it would be nice to see him practice fully tomorrow. Sampson injured his knee while returning a kickoff in Week 1 against the Jaguars and has been sidelined ever since.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dj-moore/5.headline: DJ Moore caught 4-of-6 targets for 90 yards and a touchdown in the Bills’ Week 10 win over the Jets.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dj-moore/5.analysis: Bills saw twice as many targets as the next most-targeted player on the Bills, and connected with Josh Allen on a deep 45-yard touchdown pass in the third quarter. When he’s been healthy, Moore has been a really solid weapon in this Buffalo offense, and should be a high-end WR2 next week against the Dolphins.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dj-moore/5.headline: DJ Moore caught 3-of-5 targets for 25 yards in the Bills’ Week 9 win over the Vikings, adding 11 yards on one carry.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dj-moore/5.analysis: The carry was really a pass that barely went backwards on a screen in the fourth quarter, bringing his yardage total on the evening to 36. Moore has struggled through injury during his first season in Buffalo and has returned a viable fantasy outing in two of five healthy games. His next opportunity comes in Week 10 against the Jets, where he will be a middling WR3.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dj-moore/5.headline: DJ Moore (shoulder) was limited on Friday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dj-moore/5.analysis: The Bills are managing Moore’s AC joint sprain fairly well. He should be expected to play in Week 9’s Monday Night Football game against the Vikings. Although it is a tough matchup, Moore remains the WR2 tier in this week’s final game.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dj-moore/5.headline: DJ Moore (shoulder) was limited on Thursday.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dj-moore/5.analysis: There was some concern that Moore may have injured his knee in Week 8 against the Ravens, but he is listed only with the same shoulder issue he has dealt with for weeks, which is good news. Moore should be treated as a WR2 in a very tough matchup against the Vikings on Monday Night Football.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dj-moore/5.headline: DJ Moore caught 4-of-7 targets for 82 yards and a touchdown in the Bills’ Week 8 win over the Ravens.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dj-moore/5.analysis: Moore’s 82 receiving yards trailed only Dalton Kincaid (86). Playing in his first game since Week 4, Moore did not appear to be slowed at all by his injured shoulder and bounced back quickly on a play where he appeared to land hard on the turf. Moore hauled in an impressive 49-yard grab in the third quarter on a drive that helped set up James Cook for a five-yard rushing touchdown, and found the end zone himself in the fourth quarter on an 11-yard score that gave Josh Allen the Bills’ franchise record for career touchdown passes. The seven targets Moore saw were on par with what have come to expect from him pre-injury, which is a good sign for him going forward. He appeared to suffer a minor knee injury near the end of the game, but said afterward it wasn’t too serious. That will be something to monitor, but assuming he’s good to go, Moore will be on the WR2 radar next week on the road against the Vikings.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dj-moore/5.headline: DJ Moore (shoulder) is active for the Bills’ Week 8 game against the Ravens.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dj-moore/5.analysis: Moore and TE Dalton Kincaid are both officially active, giving the Bills two of their top playmakers in what projects as one of the best matchups of the Week 8 slate against the Ravens. Moore returns for his first game since Week 4 and has caught 12 passes for 178 yards and one touchdown on 19 targets. He’ll profile as a fringe WR1/WR2 at home. The Bills declared WR Skyler Bell, CB Dee Alford, S Jalon Kilgore, LB Mike Danna, OG Ar’maj Reed-Adams, OT Spencer Brown, and DL Greg Gaines inactive for Week 8.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dj-moore/5.headline: ESPN’s Adam Schefter reports DJ Moore (shoulder) is expected to play in Week 8 against the Ravens.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dj-moore/5.analysis: Moore missed the Bills’ previous two games but had the bye week to get healthy. He was limited in practice throughout the week before being listed as questionable. He’s likely still not at full strength, but fantasy managers can’t be too concerned given the game environment. The Bills’ matchup with Baltimore has all of the makings of a shootout. Moore was also operating as Josh Allen’s clear No. 1 receiver before aggravating his shoulder injury. Moore is a strong WR2 option for Week 8.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dj-moore/5.headline: Bills coach Joe Brady said DJ Moore (shoulder) is questionable for Buffalo’s Week 8 game against the Ravens.
https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dj-moore/5.analysis: Moore has practiced with a non-contact jersey on, in a limited fashion, both of the first two days of the practice week after coming off bye. He got in a third limited session on Friday. This isn’t exactly an exciting run-out after the bye, but Moore probably is on the optimistic side of questionable and any fantasy player that is breathing should be elevated in a game projected to have Josh Allen and Lamar Jackson at quarterback.

https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/dj-moore/5.headline: DJ Moore (shoulder) was limited in practice Thursday.
